If you were scammed into transferring the money yourself, a different process applies; see Section 8, Item 2 (Call 110 or 96110 immediately to request a payment stop upon discovering a scam).

entries.title: Periodically review logged-in devices and authorized applications for your accounts, removing any you no longer use
entries.cost: Free. Takes a few minutes each time. The difficult part is that no one reminds you, so you have to remember to check on your own.
entries.summary: "Logged-in devices" refers to the phones and computers that currently have access to your account. If unfamiliar devices appear on the list, or software you stopped using long ago remains connected to your account, change your password first, then log out of all sessions. For email, also check whether any automatic forwarding rules were set up without your knowledge.
entries.benefit: The logged-in devices list in an account records the phones and computers that can currently use the account. The authorized applications list records third-party software that you have permitted to log in using this account. Unfamiliar devices in the list and long-disused third-party apps are the easiest traces to spot. The UK National Cyber Security Centre lists 'logins or login attempts from unfamiliar locations or at unusual times' as signs to check for a compromised account. It also notes that criminals frequently set up a forwarding rule in email accounts so that every incoming email sent to you is automatically forwarded to them as a copy, which they can then use to reset your passwords. The handling sequence it prescribes is: first check and remove unknown forwarding rules, then change your password, and then log out all devices and applications from the account. Once logged out, if anyone else wants to access your account, they will have to enter the new password. The US Federal Trade Commission also recommends logging out of all devices and deleting forwarding rules that you did not set up once you recover an account.
entries.sources: UK NCSC. Recovering a hacked account. <https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/recovering-a-hacked-account>; US FTC. How To Recover Your Hacked Email or Social Media Account. <https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/how-recover-your-hacked-email-or-social-media-account>; both are post-incident handling guidelines after an account has been compromised; 'checking proactively at intervals' is the author's practical experience
entries.notes: This entry point exists in WeChat, Alipay, email, Apple accounts, and Android accounts. If you discover an unfamiliar device, first change the password, then tap to log out of all sessions; this is the exact sequence provided by the UK National Cyber Security Centre. Rated Grade C because both sources are official operational guidelines, and no studies have calculated how much loss regular inspections can prevent.

entries.title: Do not click 'Agree to All' just to use an app: if information is not necessary, refusing your consent cannot be used as a ground to deny you service
entries.cost: Costs no money. The hard part is resisting the urge to click 'Agree to All'.
entries.summary: If an app requests your information that is not strictly necessary for providing the service, and you refuse to provide it, the app cannot deny your use on that basis. What it can collect is also limited strictly to what is needed. A map app requiring your location is necessary; a flashlight app requiring your address book is not.
entries.benefit: The law explicitly stipulates two rules. First, personal information processors shall not refuse to provide products or services on the grounds that an individual does not consent or has withdrawn consent, unless processing such personal information is necessary for providing the product or service. Second, collection must be limited to the minimum scope necessary to achieve the processing purpose, collecting only what is genuinely needed.
entries.sources: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2021). Personal Information Protection Law. NPC.gov.cn. <http://www.npc.gov.cn/npc/c2/c30834/202108/t20210820_313088.html>: Article 6 'The collection of personal information shall be limited to the minimum scope necessary to achieve the processing purpose and shall not be excessive'; Article 16 'Personal information processors shall not refuse to provide products or services on the grounds that an individual does not consent to the processing of their personal information or has withdrawn consent, except where the processing of personal information is necessary for providing the product or service'; Article 15 'Where personal information is processed based on personal consent, the individual has the right to withdraw their consent. Personal information processors shall provide a convenient method for withdrawing consent'
entries.notes: The criterion for judgment is whether the information is strictly necessary for providing the service. A map app requiring location is necessary; a flashlight app requiring contacts is not. After installing an app, first go to the app permissions page in your phone settings and turn off unnecessary permissions. When a feature actually needs them later, select 'allow only this time'.

entries.title: You have the right to inspect, copy, correct, and delete your personal information, and you can file a lawsuit if refused
entries.cost: Costs no money. Only if the other party stalls and fails to handle it do you need to file a complaint or lawsuit. A real lawsuit starts at several months, and attorney fees must be paid out of pocket, so filing a complaint first is more cost-effective. The difficult part is having to repeatedly follow up when the other party stalls.
entries.summary: You have the right to request that enterprises let you inspect, copy, correct, and delete your information. When services terminate, retention periods expire, or you withdraw consent, the enterprise is already obligated to delete it on its own initiative. If it refuses you, it must state the reasons; if it fails to act, you can sue it directly in court. Canceling an account and deleting information are two different matters; after canceling an account, you still need to submit a separate request for deletion.
entries.benefit: There are several situations where an enterprise must proactively delete your information: service has ceased, the agreed retention period has expired, you have withdrawn consent, the original purpose of collection has been achieved, and so forth. If it has not deleted it, you can demand that it delete it. If it refuses your exercise of these rights, it must state the reasons. You can directly initiate litigation in court.
entries.sources: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2021). Personal Information Protection Law. NPC.gov.cn. <http://www.npc.gov.cn/npc/c2/c30834/202108/t20210820_313088.html>: Article 45 'An individual has the right to consult and copy their personal information from a personal information processor... Where an individual requests to consult or copy their personal information, the personal information processor shall provide it in a timely manner'; Article 46 right to correction and supplementation; Article 47 lists five circumstances under which processors must proactively delete personal information, including '(1) The processing purpose has been achieved, cannot be achieved, or is no longer necessary to achieve the processing purpose', '(2) The personal information processor ceases to provide products or services, or the retention period has expired', '(3) The individual withdraws consent', and 'Where the personal information processor has not deleted it, the individual has the right to request deletion'; Article 50 'Personal information processors shall establish convenient application acceptance and processing mechanisms for individuals to exercise their rights. If rejecting an individual's request to exercise their rights, reasons shall be stated' and 'An individual may bring a lawsuit before a people's court in accordance with the law'
entries.notes: Canceling an account and deleting personal information are two different matters; after cancellation, deletion must still be separately requested. Before changing phones or selling an old phone, first log out of all accounts and unbind them on the old phone, and then restore factory settings. What the law grants you is an ex-post right of deletion; it cannot retrieve what has already been leaked on your behalf.

entries.title: Facial recognition is not mandatory to accept: if alternative methods exist, they cannot make you only scan your face; if you disagree, they must provide you with other options
entries.cost: Costs no money. When asked to scan your face, ask: 'Is there an alternative verification method?' If the other party says no, request that they provide one. The hard part is asking in person.
entries.summary: As long as there are other ways to accomplish the same task, the other party cannot require you to only scan your face. If you do not agree to facial recognition, they must offer you other alternatives such as swiping a card, entering a password, or presenting an ID card, and they are not allowed to coerce you by saying 'then we cannot process your transaction.' In places like hotel guest rooms, public bathrooms, changing rooms, and restrooms, nobody is allowed to install facial recognition equipment.
entries.benefit: The Provisions on the Safety Management of the Application of Facial Recognition Technology explicitly state: 'Where other non-facial recognition technology methods exist to achieve the same purpose or meet equivalent business requirements, facial recognition technology shall not be used as the sole verification method. Where an individual does not consent to identity verification through facial information, other reasonable and convenient methods shall be provided.' The provisions also specify: 'No organization or individual may, on the grounds of handling business or improving service quality, mislead, deceive, or coerce individuals into accepting identity verification through facial recognition technology.' If facial information is processed based on your consent, processors must obtain 'separate consent voluntarily and explicitly given under the premise of full information': asking you specifically about this single matter, and counting only when you give separate approval. You have the right to withdraw consent, and processors must provide a convenient method for withdrawal. Processing the facial information of minors under the age of 14 requires the consent of parents or other guardians. The installation of facial recognition equipment in public places 'shall be strictly necessary for maintaining public safety' and prominently display cautionary notices. No organization or individual may install such equipment inside private spaces within public places, such as hotel guest rooms, public bathhouses, public changing rooms, and public restrooms. Facial information shall be stored locally within facial recognition equipment and must not be transmitted outward over the internet, with two exceptions: where laws and administrative regulations provide otherwise, or where separate consent has been obtained (nationwide, effective June 1, 2025).
entries.sources: Cyberspace Administration of China, Ministry of Public Security (2025). Provisions on the Safety Management of the Application of Facial Recognition Technology (Order No. 19, Articles 10, 12, 13, and 15, effective June 1, 2025). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-03/21/c_1744174262156096.htm>
entries.notes: The most common occurrences are residential access gates, rental platforms, gyms, and hotels demanding that you register your face. When the other party says 'the system only supports facial scanning,' read the exact wording of the provisions to them. The original wording is: 'Where other non-facial recognition technology methods exist to achieve the same purpose or meet equivalent business requirements, facial recognition technology shall not be used as the sole verification method.' Then request that they provide an alternative method, such as swiping an access card, a password, or an ID card. If they still refuse, report them to the local cyberspace administration department. Where national regulations provide otherwise regarding facial verification of identity—such as in certain financial and government affairs scenarios—follow those regulations. The biggest difference between a face and a password is that it cannot be changed once leaked, so it warrants even greater caution than a password. Entities that store facial information of more than 100,000 individuals must file a record with the provincial-level or higher cyberspace administration department within 30 working days; asking about this is also a way to assess whether an entity is compliant. For rights to inspect, correct, and delete personal information, see Item 8. Someone borrowing your face to take out a loan for themselves is another matter; see Section 8, Item 45 (Helping someone scan your face).

entries.title: Do not hand over code, secret keys, and private data to 'AI relay stations' of unknown origin, especially when allowing AI to execute commands automatically
entries.cost: Direct official connections are typically more expensive than relay stations, and topping up accounts is not as convenient. The difficulty lies in the fact that relay stations are cheap and allow calling models from multiple providers through a single access point
entries.summary: A relay station sits between you and the model vendor; it can see and modify both the content you send out and the responses returned. A study tested over 400 relay stations: 9 injected malicious code into responses, and 17 accessed cloud service secret keys intentionally planted by the researchers. If you allow AI to automatically execute commands, a single tampered command can cause malicious code to be installed on your computer.
entries.benefit: In June 2026, the Ministry of State Security issued a risk warning. Some relay stations retain data submitted by users on their servers, with some covertly intercepting and reselling it to other large model vendors for training. Others harbor backdoors, implanting malicious code into users' devices, stealing account keys and cloud credentials, and even installing remote control programs. The warning recommends using direct official connections and formally licensed platforms, and avoiding platforms of unknown origin, lacking operating qualifications, or lacking security protections. When using them, desensitize personal privacy and project materials beforehand, manage keys securely, and rotate them regularly. If abnormal charges, unprovoked account bans, or data anomalies occur, immediately cease use, change keys, scan for viruses, and preserve evidence. In 2026, researchers from institutions including the University of California, Santa Barbara conducted an empirical measurement. They purchased 28 paid relay stations from Taobao, Xianyu, and overseas online shops, and collected 400 free relay stations from public communities. As a result, 1 paid and 8 free relay stations injected malicious code into returned tool calls. Tool calls are commands that the AI instructs your computer to execute, such as installing software packages. Another 2 picked specific moments to strike; the paper cited the example of targeting only fully automated execution sessions. Seventeen accessed Amazon Web Services secret keys intentionally planted by the researchers. One transferred funds out of the researchers' Ethereum wallet; only a minimal amount of funds had been placed in the wallet, resulting in a loss of less than 50 USD. The modification method demonstrated in the paper was highly stealthy: replacing `requests` in an installation command with the similarly spelled `reqeusts`, which is unnoticeable at a glance (nationwide)
entries.sources: Ministry of State Security (2026). 'AI Relay Stations': Risks Must Be Guarded Against. <https://www.szzg.gov.cn/2026/xwzx/szkx/202606/t20260608_5331487.htm> (Digital China Construction Summit official website reposting Ministry of State Security WeChat official account); Liu H, Shou C, Wen H, Chen Y, Fang RJ, Feng Y. (2026). Your Agent Is Mine: Measuring Malicious Intermediary Attacks on the LLM Supply Chain. arXiv:2604.08407. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08407>
entries.notes: Rated Grade B because there is only one study and it is a preprint (a version released publicly before formal publication). Most of the relay stations tested were free, with only 28 paid ones, making it impossible to calculate 'what percentage of relay stations are problematic.' Some media outlets reported that theft as 500,000 USD, whereas the original text of the paper states less than 50 USD. Benefit magnitude is rated as medium based on consequences: the magnitude of losses from stolen secret keys and code varies widely, and no monetary figure from the study can be universally applied. If you have already used a relay station of unknown origin, revoke and regenerate used secret keys with the model vendor, and replace keys for cloud services and code repositories at the same time. When routing through a relay station, do not let AI execute commands fully autonomously; inspect commands before permitting execution. Operating a relay station carries criminal risks; see Section 11, Item 19 (AI relay stations). The beneficiary is yourself.

entries.title: Check once a year how many SIM cards and bank cards are under your name, and cancel any that you did not open yourself
entries.cost: Costs no money. Check SIM cards via the 'Gongxin Weibao' (MIIT Micro-Reports) official account or the 'One-Certificate All-Check' (Yizheng Tongcha) mini-program on Alipay; check bank cards via 'One-Click Card Check' (Yijian Chaka) in the Cloud QuickPass (Yunshanfu) app. Each takes a few minutes to fill out, and results will be notified to you by SMS within one to two days. The difficult part is that no one reminds you, so you have to remember to check once a year yourself.
entries.summary: Some individuals fraudulently use other people's identity cards to obtain SIM cards to commit fraud, often without the victims' knowledge. Free official query channels are now available to check how many SIM cards are under your name, how many app accounts are linked to your phone number, and which UnionPay cards you hold. If you discover unfamiliar ones, contact the telecommunications operator or bank to verify and cancel them.
entries.benefit: The Anti-Telecom and Online Fraud Law stipulates that competent telecommunications departments shall 'provide convenient channels for users to query information on SIM cards under their names.' The People's Bank of China and other authorities shall 'provide convenient channels for customers to query bank accounts and payment accounts under their names.' The nationwide mobile phone card 'One-Certificate All-Check' service, guided by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), was launched on September 14, 2021. Using an ID card, one can query the quantity of SIM cards under one's name and their corresponding telecom operators. It was introduced because authorities combating telecom fraud discovered that some SIM cards involved in cases had been fraudulently opened under other people's identities. The users themselves were unaware, and their personal credit could also be affected. Results are sent via SMS from 10699000 within 48 hours. If the count does not match, you can check details with the operator; upon authorization by the individual, cards can be verified, separated, suspended, or cancelled. In July 2022, 'One-Certificate All-Check 2.0' was launched. Using a mobile phone number and the last six digits of an ID card number, one can check how many internet accounts are linked to that number. At that time, it supported enterprises including Tencent, Alibaba, Baidu, Kuaishou, Douyin, JD.com, and Meituan, and the results only provided the count. As for the bank card component, China UnionPay made the Cloud QuickPass 'One-Click Card Check' available across all provinces and municipalities in Mainland China on June 29, 2022. Once you select the banks to query and pass identity authentication, you can submit the request. A report is generated within 24 hours, in which card information is desensitized, and automatically deleted after 7 days (nationwide)
entries.sources: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2022). Anti-Telecom and Online Fraud Law (Articles 10 and 16). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202209/t20220902_575631.shtml>; People's Daily Online (2021). MIIT launches 'One-Certificate All-Check' service: users can query the quantity of SIM cards under their names. Reposted by the Central People's Government Portal, 2021-09-15. <http://app.www.gov.cn/govdata/gov/202109/15/475868/article.html>; Xinhua News Agency (2022). MIIT launches 'One-Certificate All-Check 2.0' service. Reposted by Department of Industry and Information Technology of Fujian Province, 2022-07-22. <https://gxt.fujian.gov.cn/zwgk/xw/jxyw/202207/t20220722_5958108.htm>; China UnionPay (2022). Cloud QuickPass app 'One-Click Card Check' function opened to all domestic provinces and municipalities. <https://cn.unionpay.com/upowhtml/cn/templates/newInfo-nosub/7885004da382485e8bde5a0ba000fdd3/20220629145824.html>
entries.notes: 'One-Click Card Check' only queries UnionPay cards. UnionPay explained at the time that cards without a phone number on file with the bank or with an expired ID card cannot yet be queried, and records are subject to the card-issuing bank's records; therefore, not showing up in the search does not mean they do not exist. Fraudulently opened loans and credit cards require checking credit reports; see Section 8, Item 9 (Credit reports). For phone numbers that One-Certificate All-Check 2.0 shows as linked to many accounts, unbind them before changing or discontinuing the number; see Item 12 (Before changing phone numbers or stopping the use of an old number). Lending or selling your own cards to others is another matter; see Section 8, Item 8 (Do not give, lend, or sell bank cards or SIM cards). Rated Grade C because sources are all official service instructions, and no studies have calculated how much loss checking can prevent. Benefit magnitude is rated as medium based on judgment. The beneficiary is yourself.

entries.title: Before changing phone numbers or stopping the use of an old number, first rebind bank, payment, and social media accounts to the new number; do not simply let the old number lapse into service suspension from overdue bills
entries.cost: Costs no money. You need to rebind phone numbers account by account, and the mobile phone number on file with banks must be updated through the banks. If you have many frequently used accounts, it may take one to two hours from start to finish. The difficult part is that it is easy to miss some, as rarely used accounts do not easily come to mind.
entries.summary: After a mobile number is cancelled, telecommunications operators can reassign it to someone else in as few as 90 days. Un-rebound accounts remain connected to that number, verification codes will be sent to the new number owner's phone, and they might log in to your accounts using those verification codes. Therefore, before changing numbers, update all accounts and mobile numbers on file with banks to your new number first.
entries.benefit: The Telecommunication Service Standards specify that 'the freeze period for mobile telephone numbers shall be at least 90 days,' referring to the duration between number cancellation and reactivation. 90 days after cancellation, the number may be assigned to a new user. The MIIT Telecommunications Service Quality Announcement for the first quarter of 2025 reminded users that they can use the 'Recycled Number Refresh' service in the apps of the three major operators. When receiving a previously used number, this service can be used to unbind internet accounts registered and bound before opening the account. The announcement for the second quarter of 2026 stated that this service has covered 258 common internet applications, with over 850 million application unbinding requests processed. The fact that new number owners have to specifically unbind them demonstrates that the previous owner's accounts are still linked to the number when it reaches their hands. In 2024, customer service representatives from the three major telecom operators were interviewed by the People's Posts and Telecommunications News. They stated that after a number is cancelled, new users can still log into accounts registered by previous users via SMS verification codes. They advised users to unbind applications such as Alipay and WeChat before changing or cancelling numbers, and to update mobile numbers on file for bank cards promptly (nationwide)
entries.sources: Ministry of Information Industry (2005). Telecommunication Service Specifications (Ministry of Information Industry Decree No. 36, Appendix 2, Item 2.1.7). <https://www.miit.gov.cn/zwgk/zcwj/flfg/art/2020/art_0cff75e226764dc7b811cd4e954415c5.html>; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (2025). Announcement on Telecommunication Service Quality for the First Quarter of 2025 (MIIT Letter on Telecom Regulation [2025] No. 85). <https://www.miit.gov.cn/jgsj/xgj/fwjd/art/2025/art_1bcadc32bf8141a8b616db8eaadba2e9.html>; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (2026). Announcement on Telecommunication Service Quality for the Second Quarter of 2026 (MIIT Letter on Telecom Regulation [2026] No. 258). Reprinted by the Communications Administration of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. <https://nmca.miit.gov.cn/xwdt/xydt/art/2026/art_2f6af9120a064a6784557cdefbf1c5be.html>; Li Yue (2024). Three Major Telecom Operators Remind Users: Be Sure to Unbind Accounts Before Changing or Canceling Mobile Phone Numbers. People's Posts and Telecommunications News, reprinted by the Cyberspace Administration of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Region Committee, 2024-04-08. <https://wxb.xzdw.gov.cn/wlaq/aqdt/202404/t20240408_456634.html> (Web archive <https://web.archive.org/web/20250414055537/https://wxb.xzdw.gov.cn/wlaq/aqdt/202404/t20240408_456634.html>)
entries.notes: First, use "One-ID Query 2.0" to check how many accounts are linked to the old number; see Item 11 (How many phone cards are under your name). First modify banking and payment accounts, then modify social media accounts, and directly cancel accounts you no longer use. Do not suspend or cancel the phone number immediately after making the changes; keep it for one or two months to receive missed SMS verification codes. This is based on the author's experience. The point that a new number owner can log in using verification codes comes from statements made by operator customer service representatives in media reports, with no official announcement or judgment. For how to handle a situation after someone has logged into your account, see Item 6 (Login devices). Replacing or selling an old phone requires additionally logging out of accounts and restoring factory settings, which is written in the notes for Item 8 (Deleting your personal information). Rated Level C because no studies have calculated how much less is lost by unbinding and rebinding. The magnitude of benefit is judged to be medium. The beneficiary is yourself.

chapters.title: Renting and Buying a Home
chapters.intro: Metric: Money. In renting, the places where you are most prone to losing money are deposits and real estate agencies. In buying a home, the most expensive parts are mortgage interest, plus those things that the seller knows but you do not know. The last few items in this section discuss buying a home: which account money should be paid into, when earnest money deposits and house payments can be reclaimed, and what to do if handover of the home is delayed. There is also how to prevent the seller from selling one property to two buyers, and how to negotiate mortgage interest rates downward. The final two items discuss after moving in: property management cannot cut off water or electricity to press for property management fees, and for leaks in newly built homes within the warranty period, seek repairs from the developer.

entries.title: When renting, the deposit amount, return time, and deduction circumstances must be written into the contract
entries.cost: Costs no money. Takes ten extra minutes when signing the contract. The difficulty lies in bringing it up in front of the landlord
entries.summary: How much the deposit is, when it will be refunded, and under what circumstances it can be deducted must be written into the contract before signing. The landlord cannot use deduction reasons that are not written in the contract to withhold your deposit when moving out.
entries.benefit: Administrative regulations state very clearly: "Where the lessor collects a deposit, matters such as the amount of the deposit, the time of return, and circumstances under which the deposit may be deducted shall be stipulated in the residential leasing contract. Except for the circumstances agreed upon in the residential leasing contract, the lessor shall not deduct the deposit without legitimate reasons." Three things must be written into the contract: how much deposit is collected, when it is returned, and under what circumstances deductions can be made. The landlord cannot use reasons not written in the contract to withhold your money
entries.sources: State Council (2025). Regulations on Housing Leasing (State Council Decree No. 812, effective September 15, 2025) (Article 10). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032956.htm>
entries.notes: Take photos and record videos together with the landlord on the day of moving out. Photograph readings of water meters, electricity meters, and gas meters, as well as walls and floors. If the deposit is withheld without cause, first file a complaint with the housing leasing administrative department. For small amounts, pursue small-claims litigation; see Section 8. For whether a leased storefront can be opened for business and whether catering permits can be processed, see Section 12, Item 27 (Renting a storefront to open a shop).

entries.title: If water or power is cut off, locks are changed, or threats are made at your door to evict you, call the police first to preserve evidence: regulations prohibit using these methods to force you to vacate
entries.cost: Costs no money. Make a phone call to the police; it can be done on the spot
entries.summary: The landlord cannot rely on cutting off water or power, changing locks, or making in-person threats to force you to terminate the contract or move out; regulations explicitly prohibit this. If encountered, call the police first to preserve evidence. Do not take matters into your own hands to confront the other party physically.
entries.benefit: Administrative regulations state very clearly: "The lessor shall not adopt violence, threats, or other illegal means to compel the lessee to terminate the residential leasing contract or vacate the leased residence." Vacating means making you move out. If encountering this type of situation, call the police first to preserve evidence. Do not take matters into your own hands to confront them
entries.sources: State Council (2025). Regulations on Housing Leasing (State Council Decree No. 812, effective September 15, 2025) (Article 12). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032956.htm>
entries.notes: Calling the police is to leave a police dispatch record, which serves as evidence when claiming damages later. At the same time, notify the housing leasing administrative department

entries.title: Agencies may not collect or pay rent and deposits on behalf of others; pay the money directly to the landlord
entries.cost: Costs no money. Verify the payee before paying, which takes a few minutes. The difficulty lies in resisting the agency's claim that you should transfer the money to them
entries.summary: According to regulations, rent and deposits cannot be collected or paid through agencies; pay the money directly to the landlord. Having money pass through an agency's hands creates an extra opportunity for them to abscond with the funds. Before paying, verify whether the payee is the name on the property ownership certificate.
entries.benefit: Administrative regulations list "collecting or paying residential rent or deposits on behalf of others" as prohibited conduct for real estate brokerage agencies; agencies cannot collect your rent and deposit on behalf of the landlord. Having money pass through an agency's hands creates an extra opportunity for them to abscond with the funds
entries.sources: State Council (2025). Regulations on Housing Leasing (State Council Decree No. 812, effective September 15, 2025) (Article 25). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032956.htm>
entries.notes: Before paying, verify whether the payee matches the name on the property ownership certificate. If it is not the person themselves, ask clearly and keep a written authorization. The agency can only charge intermediary service fees for matchmaking and brokerage

entries.title: When renting a long-term rental apartment, check its fund escrow account first; do not pay one full year upfront just to get a discount
entries.cost: Costs no money. Takes ten-odd minutes to check once
entries.summary: If you pay one year upfront, the discount you receive is only that small amount. Once the company absconds, your deposit and the remaining ten-plus months of rent may vanish together. It is even worse if bundled with a rental loan: if the apartment company flees, you will still have to repay the loan on a monthly basis. Before signing the contract, check whether it has publicly disclosed a fund escrow account.
entries.benefit: Administrative regulations require housing leasing enterprises operating subleasing businesses to "establish a residential leasing fund escrow account and disclose it to the public." Operating a subleasing business refers to an enterprise renting the entire property from the landlord and then subleasing it to you. The small discount obtained by paying one year upfront does not compensate for the risk of both the deposit and remaining rent vanishing together if the enterprise absconds. For those who concurrently sign for a rental loan, the risk is even greater
entries.sources: State Council (2025). Regulations on Housing Leasing (State Council Decree No. 812, effective September 15, 2025) (Article 19). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032956.htm>
entries.notes: When signing the contract, read clearly whether a loan is bundled. If an installment financing app paid the entire year's money to the apartment company at once and you repay the loan monthly, you must continue repaying even if the apartment company absconds. Do not sign this kind of contract

entries.title: If the house is sold during the lease term, the lease agreement remains valid and you do not need to move
entries.cost: Costs no money
entries.summary: If the house is sold during the lease term, your lease agreement remains equally valid. The new landlord must let you live there until expiration according to the original contract. You do not need to move, nor do you need to renegotiate the price. The prerequisite is that you already occupy it lawfully; keep evidence of the contract, bank transfer records, and move-in time well preserved.
entries.benefit: There is a clause in the Civil Code called "sale does not break lease." The exact legal wording is: where a change occurs in the ownership of the leased object during the lease term, the validity of the lease contract shall not be affected. If the house changes owners during the lease term, the signed lease agreement remains valid as before. The new landlord must let you live there until expiration in accordance with the original contract
entries.sources: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 725). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>
entries.notes: The prerequisite is that you have already lawfully moved in; the phrasing in the legal provision is lawful possession and use. Retain evidence of the contract, bank transfer records, and move-in time

entries.title: Before signing a rental contract, verify the property ownership certificate and mortgage status; make all payments via bank transfer and note the purpose
entries.cost: Costs no money. Take your ID card and make a trip to the real estate registration agency; an inquiry takes half an hour. The difficulty lies in having the landlord produce the property ownership certificate in person
entries.summary: Before signing the contract, have the landlord present their ID card and property ownership certificate. Then take your ID card to the real estate registration agency to check whether the property is mortgaged or seized by a court; this can be checked even without having signed a contract. For properties mortgaged or seized prior to leasing, if they are auctioned and change ownership, you cannot demand to continue living there. Make all payments via bank transfer and note their purpose to leave proof.
entries.benefit: Before signing the contract, the landlord must present identification materials and the real property title certificate to you. If there is no property ownership certificate, other materials proving their legal right to lease must be produced. The landlord must also cooperate with you in querying and verifying the information of this property; this is an obligation stipulated by administrative regulations for lessors. Even before signing a contract, taking your ID card to the real estate registration agency of the city or county where the property is located allows you to check several items. Items that can be queried include: the basic status of the property, whether there are co-owners, whether there is a mortgage or registered right of habitation, and whether it has been seized by a court. After signing the contract, you can check the registration results based on the leasing contract. This step is critical because "sale does not break lease" has two exceptions. If the property was mortgaged to a bank prior to leasing and was later auctioned to satisfy the debt, you cannot demand that the new property owner allow you to continue living there according to the original contract. The same applies if the property was already seized by a court prior to leasing. In a judicial auction, if the lease impedes the prior mortgage right, the court will first extinguish the lease before conducting the auction. Conversely, if it was leased to you first, you already moved in, and the landlord only mortgaged it later, the mortgage does not affect your lease. If the property is seized or its title is disputed, resulting in you being unable to reside there, you may terminate the contract. If another party asserts rights and prevents you from living there, you may demand a reduction in or exemption from rent. Making all payments via bank transfer and noting "Rent for [Property Name] for [Month]" comes from the author's experience: in the event of a dispute, it proves that you paid money and what the money was paid for
entries.sources: State Council (2025). Regulations on Housing Leasing (State Council Decree No. 812, effective September 15, 2025) (Article 9, Item 1: "Present to the lessee identification materials, the real property title certificate of the residence proposed for lease, or other materials proving the legal right to lease, and cooperate with the lessee in querying and verifying relevant information of the residence proposed for lease in accordance with the law"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032956.htm>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2024 Amendment). Interim Measures for the Query of Real Estate Registration Materials (Articles 8, 19, 20, 21). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11506/202408/content_6966482.html>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2025). Decision on Amending the Interim Measures for the Query of Real Estate Registration Materials (Ministry of Natural Resources Decree No. 18, amending Article 21, Item 3 to "Whether circumstances such as mortgage right registration, pre-notice registration, objection registration, or right of habitation registration exist for the real estate"). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_12546/202602/content_7057456.html>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 405, 723, 724, 725). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2020). Decision on Amending Twenty-Seven Civil Judicial Interpretations Including the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the 'Trade Union Law of the People's Republic of China' in Civil Trial Work" (Fa Shi [2020] No. 17, Item 21, Point 6 amending the original Article 20 of the Interpretation on Urban Housing Lease Contracts, renumbered as Article 14 after adjusting article order: "(1) Where a mortgage right was established on the house before leasing, and a change of ownership occurs due to the mortgagee realizing the mortgage right; (2) Where the house was seized by a people's court in accordance with the law before leasing"). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>; Supreme People's Court (2004). Provisions on the Auction and Sale of Property in Civil Enforcement by People's Courts (Fa Shi [2004] No. 16, Article 31, Paragraph 2; renumbered as Article 28, Paragraph 2 after Articles 5 through 7 were deleted by Fa Shi [2020] No. 21). <https://www.court.gov.cn/shenpan/xiangqing/713.html>; Supreme People's Court (2020). Decision on Amending Eighteen Enforcement Judicial Interpretations Including the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Distraint of Railway Freight by People's Courts" (Fa Shi [2020] No. 21). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282661.html>; for evidence preservation and bank transfer remarks, see also the two items regarding betrothal gifts and IOU notes in Section 8 for the same logic
entries.notes: Among the items that can be checked before signing a contract, who the property owner is is not included. Therefore, the name on the property ownership certificate must be matched in person against the landlord's ID card. Ensure the landlord themselves is present when signing the contract; if the person cannot come, demand a power of attorney. If a sub-landlord subleases to you, written consent from the original landlord is required. For rights such as terminating the contract and paying less rent, if the landlord does not acknowledge them, a lawsuit must be filed in court. Under ordinary procedure, the first instance is required to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended; attorney fees are generally paid out of pocket. Noting the purpose in bank transfer remarks is not directly stipulated by regulations; it is the author's experience. This kind of inquiry can also be conducted before signing a contract to buy a pre-owned home; after signing, pre-notice registration must also be handled, see Item 14 (Pre-notice registration).

entries.title: When using an agency to collect house payments for a pre-owned home, payments must go through the dedicated transaction capital deposit account opened by the agency at a bank
entries.cost: Costs no money. The difficulty lies in insisting on using the dedicated account, which may require arguing a bit more with the agency
entries.summary: Where an agency collects house payments on behalf of parties, regulations stipulate it must go through a dedicated account opened by the agency at a bank. This account is supervised; funds cannot be paid into the agency's general account, nor transferred to an individual broker.
entries.benefit: Administrative rules state very clearly: where real estate transaction parties agree that real estate brokerage agencies collect or pay transaction funds on their behalf, the funds shall be transferred through the dedicated client transaction settlement fund deposit accounts opened by the agencies at banks. The house payments enter a regulated dedicated account, not the agency's own general account, nor the private account of a particular broker
entries.sources: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2011). Measures for the Administration of Real Estate Brokerage (Decree No. 8, amended by Decree No. 29 in 2016), Article 24: "Where real estate transaction parties agree that real estate brokerage agencies collect or pay transaction funds on their behalf, transaction funds shall be transferred through dedicated client transaction settlement fund deposit accounts opened by real estate brokerage agencies at banks." Article 18: "Real estate brokerage services shall implement a system of clearly marked prices... stating real estate brokerage service items, service contents, and fee standards at prominent locations in business premises"; Article 19: "Where two or more real estate brokerage agencies collaborate to carry out the same real estate brokerage business, commissions may only be collected based on a single transaction, and no additional fees shall be charged to the client"; Article 17: other services such as handling loans and real estate registration on behalf of clients "shall explain service contents, fee standards, and other circumstances to the client, and enter into a separate contract after obtaining the client's consent." <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1918920.htm>
entries.notes: A house payment ranges from several hundred thousand to several million yuan, making it the single largest monetary transaction in this book; do not transfer it to a broker via WeChat. There are also two common ways of overcharging. The first is when two agencies collaborate on the same transaction; in this case, only one commission may be charged. The second is handling loans or title transfers on your behalf; these constitute separate services that require signing a separate contract and disclosing fees in advance. For making all payments via bank transfer and noting the purpose, see Item 6 (Verifying the property ownership certificate and mortgage status before signing). For where money for buying off-plan homes is deposited, see Item 10 (Presale fund escrow accounts).

entries.title: Do not rent partitioned rooms: the minimum rental unit is the originally designed room; kitchens, bathrooms, and balconies must not be used for habitation
entries.cost: Costs no money. The trade-off is that for the same budget, you either live slightly farther away or slightly smaller
entries.summary: According to regulations, the minimum rental unit is the room as originally designed. Kitchens, bathrooms, balconies, and underground storage rooms must not be lived in. In addition, the landlord cannot unilaterally raise the rent at will during the lease term.
entries.benefit: Administrative rules state very clearly that the minimum rental unit is the originally designed room; one room cannot be further partitioned into several rooms to be rented out separately. The per capita leased floor area shall not be lower than the minimum standards set by the local people's government. Kitchens, bathrooms, balconies, and underground storage rooms must not be leased for human habitation. Lessors shall also not unilaterally increase rent levels at will during the housing lease term. For violations of Article 8, the competent department shall order the lessor to make corrections within a time limit; if corrections are not made within the time limit, a fine ranging from 5,000 yuan to 30,000 yuan may be imposed
entries.sources: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (2010). Administrative Measures for Commodity Housing Leasing (Decree No. 6), Article 8: "When leasing housing, the originally designed room shall serve as the minimum rental unit, and the per capita leased floor area shall not be lower than the minimum standards set by the local people's government. Kitchens, bathrooms, balconies, and underground storage rooms must not be leased for human habitation." Article 9: "The lessor shall fulfill housing maintenance obligations in accordance with the contract agreement and ensure the safety of the housing and indoor facilities... During the term of the housing leasing contract, the lessor shall not unilaterally increase rent levels at will." Article 22: "Anyone who violates the provisions of Article 8 of these Measures shall be ordered to make corrections within a time limit by the construction (real estate) competent department of the people's government of a municipality directly under the Central Government, city, or county; if corrections are not made within the time limit, a fine of not less than 5,000 yuan but not more than 30,000 yuan may be imposed." <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1845070.htm>
entries.notes: When illegal partitioning is investigated and penalized, the fine is levied on the lessor. However, making corrections requires dismantling the partitions, leaving tenants living inside with no choice but to move out; this is deduced from this provision. Deposits and already-paid rent often cannot be recovered; this is based on the author's experience. Safety is also poor: partition walls often block escape routes, and having many people living in one apartment sharing a single electrical circuit is common. When viewing a property, pay attention to three points: whether the walls were built later, whether the room has windows, and whether the electricity meter can handle so many people.

entries.title: If an urban household registration holder wants to move to the countryside, only rent rural houses; do not buy homesteads or houses built on homesteads
entries.cost: Costs no money. The trade-off is that the house does not belong to you, each lease term is at most 20 years, and you must renegotiate with the landlord upon expiration
entries.summary: People with urban household registration cannot go to rural areas to buy homesteads, farmers' residences, or "small property right homes"; national documents explicitly prohibit this. Even if villagers say "writing a contract is enough," it is still not valid. If you want to live in the countryside long-term, sign a lease contract, signing for at most 20 years at a time, and renew it upon expiration.
entries.benefit: Documents of the General Office of the State Council state very clearly: "Urban residents shall not go to rural areas to purchase homesteads, farmers' residential dwellings, or 'small property right homes'." The same document also stipulates that after farmers sell or lease out their residential dwellings, subsequent applications for homesteads will not be approved. A 2019 document from the Office of the Central Rural Work Leading Group and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs reiterated: "Urban residents are strictly prohibited from purchasing homesteads in rural areas." The same document provided a lawful path: urban residents may rent rural houses for residential or business purposes. The term of the lease contract shall not exceed twenty years, and upon expiration, both parties may agree otherwise
entries.sources: General Office of the State Council (2007). Notice on Strictly Implementing Laws and Policies on Rural Collective Construction Land (Guobanfa [2007] No. 71). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_2395.htm>; Office of the Central Rural Work Leading Group, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (2019). Notice on Further Strengthening the Management of Rural Homesteads (Zhongnongfa [2019] No. 11), Parts 5 and 6. <https://www.moa.gov.cn/govpublic/NCJJTZ/201909/t20190920_6328397.htm>
entries.notes: A homestead land parcel (*zhaijidi*) is land allocated by a village to its own villagers for housing construction, and it can only be allocated to members of that village. When renting a rural house, sign a written contract with the renting rural household, clearly specifying the lease term, rent, whether renovations and alterations are permitted, and how renovation expenses are calculated upon expiration. Regulatory documents stipulate that the lease term cannot exceed 20 years; do not sign contracts such as "leasing for 50 years" or "leasing for 70 years," and even less should you pay rent for multiple years in a single lump sum. Regulatory documents also prohibit going down to rural areas to use homestead land to build villa compounds and private clubhouses; do not put up money to "jointly build" with villagers.

entries.title: When buying off-plan housing, check the pre-sale permit first; transfer the earnest money, down payment, and mortgage loans solely into the pre-sale funds escrow account specified in the contract
entries.cost: Costs no money. Take a look at the pre-sale permit before signing the contract, and verify the account before making payments—a few minutes. The difficult part lies in persisting in not transferring the money when the salesperson asks you to transfer it to another account.
entries.summary: Off-plan housing refers to homes that are put up for sale before construction is completed. Without a pre-sale permit, developers are not permitted to sell, nor can they collect earnest money. Regulations require that the down payment and mortgage loans you pay must entirely enter an escrow account, and supervision will only be released once the house is ready for delivery. If money is transferred to other accounts, it falls outside this layer of protection.
entries.benefit: Off-plan housing is referred to in regulations as commodity housing pre-sale, where a developer sells a home under construction to you in advance. In August 2026, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Natural Resources, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued a document stipulating: "All home purchase funds, such as down payments and personal residential mortgage loans paid by homebuyers, shall be entirely deposited into funds escrow accounts." Escrow supervision is lifted only after the building completes completion acceptance inspections and possesses the conditions for delivery of water, electricity, gas, and heating. The developer must clearly specify the rights and liabilities regarding the deposit of home purchase funds into the escrow account within the home purchase contract. If the developer breaches the contract and fails to deliver the home on schedule, you can terminate the contract pursuant to contractual agreements. The developer must refund the money in accordance with the contract and bear liability for breach of contract. The People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration simultaneously stipulated that for personal residential mortgage loans used to purchase pre-sale housing, the bank must directly disburse the funds into the project's pre-sale funds escrow account. The 2022 three-department document had already clearly stated that earnest money, down payments, and mortgage loans "shall all be deposited directly into the escrow account." For real estate developments that have not obtained a pre-sale permit, developers must not conduct pre-sales, nor may they collect earnest money through means such as subscription, reservations, queuing numbers, or issuing VIP cards. Pre-sale contracts signed without a pre-sale permit are determined by courts to be invalid. Where the permit is obtained supplementary before a lawsuit is filed, the contract may be determined to be valid. If money is paid to a destination outside the escrow account, it is not covered by this supervisory system. The same 2026 document also stipulated that after projects sold as completed existing housing obtain a construction permit, the developer may collect a "small amount of earnest money" in advance. Such earnest money is supervised by the housing funds regulatory agency, deposited in an "earnest money escrow account" opened at the project's lead bank, and supervision is only lifted after the housing possesses the delivery conditions.
entries.sources: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Natural Resources, National Financial Regulatory Administration (2026). Notice on Improving the Commercial Housing Sales System (Jian Fang Gui [2026] No. 3, Part I, Items (2) and (3); Part II, Item (3)). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_13026/202610/content_7082773.html>; People's Bank of China, National Financial Regulatory Administration (2026). Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Construction of a New Model of Real Estate Development (Yin Fa [2026] No. 171, Article 22). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_13026/202610/content_7082770.html>; General Office of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, General Office of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, General Office of the People's Bank of China (2022). Notice on Relevant Work Concerning Commercial Banks Issuing Letters of Guarantee to Replace Pre-Sale Escrow Funds (Yin Bao Jian Ban Fa [2022] No. 104, Article 2). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-11/14/content_5726954.htm>; Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (2010). Notice on Issues Concerning Further Strengthening Real Estate Market Supervision and Improving the Commodity Housing Pre-Sale System (Jian Fang [2010] No. 53, Part I, Item (1); Part II, Item (9)). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2010/content_1629136.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2020 Amendment). Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes Over Contracts for the Sale of Commodity Housing (Amended Text of Fa Shi [2020] No. 17, Article 2). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>
entries.notes: For real estate projects that obtained a construction engineering planning permit before August 28, 2026, pre-sale conditions and funds escrow are handled according to the original local regulations. The requirement that down payments and loans must enter escrow accounts had already been mandated by both the 2010 and 2022 documents. For projects sold as completed existing housing where the developer collects a small earnest money deposit during the construction period, new rules require the earnest money to enter an earnest money escrow account. The account name and account number of the escrow account are governed by what is written in the home purchase contract; double-check them once before paying. If the contract is determined to be invalid and the developer refuses to refund the money, you need to file a lawsuit in court. First-instance ordinary procedure is required by regulation to conclude within 6 months, which can be extended; attorney fees are generally borne by yourself. For how to pay the purchase price for second-hand housing, see Item 7 (Dedicated Deposit Account for Transaction Funds).

entries.title: If you paid a subscription earnest money deposit or down payment for a new home, failed to conclude a formal contract, or could not get mortgage loan approval (such as policy tightening or bank lending suspensions occurring after signing) through no fault of your own, demand that the developer refund the money
entries.cost: Costs no money. Read two extra clauses carefully when signing the subscription agreement and the formal contract. If the developer refuses to refund, you will have to sue in court.
entries.summary: If you paid a subscription earnest money deposit but failed to sign a formal contract, or if the loan failed to get approved, first look at who was at fault. If the cause is attributable neither to you nor to the developer, the developer must refund the earnest money, or refund the housing payment plus interest. Policy tightening or bank lending freezes after contract signing are generally considered attributable to neither party. If you had personal credit overdue records or insufficient income, it counts as your fault, and you may not be able to get the earnest money back.
entries.benefit: The judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court explicitly states: where a developer collects an earnest money deposit through subscription, ordering, or reservations, and a formal sales contract fails to be concluded due to reasons attributable to one of the parties, the matter shall be handled in accordance with the earnest money rules. The earnest money rule is: if the party paying the earnest money breaches the contract, the earnest money is not refunded; if the party receiving the earnest money breaches the contract, double the earnest money is refunded—see Section 12, Item 15 (Writing Earnest Money When Receiving Money). Where conclusion fails due to reasons attributable to neither party, "the seller shall return the earnest money to the buyer." Another article addresses loans. Where a sales contract stipulates payment by loan, and due to reasons attributable to one party the loan contract fails to be concluded and the sales contract cannot be performed, the other party may terminate the contract and claim damages. Where the loan contract fails to be concluded due to reasons attributable to neither party, both parties may terminate the contract. The developer must refund the principal and interest of the home purchase funds received, or refund the earnest money. As for what counts as attributable to neither party, statutory articles only provide principles; the following are examples provided by the author. A local tightening of mortgage policies or bank suspension of mortgage lending after signing is generally considered attributable to neither party. If you have overdue records on your personal credit report or your verified income bank flow is insufficient, it counts as your reason. If the real estate development lacks complete official permits and procedures or banks refuse to extend loans to this project, it counts as the developer's reason. These two provisions apply only to commodity housing purchased from developers and do not apply to second-hand home purchases.
entries.sources: Supreme People's Court (2020 Amendment). Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes Over Contracts for the Sale of Commodity Housing (Articles 1, 4, 5, and 19). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 586 and 587). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>
entries.notes: What counts as "attributable to neither party" is determined by the court based on specific circumstances when disputes arise. Therefore, the formal contract should explicitly state payment by mortgage loan, and it is best to further clarify what happens if the mortgage fails to be approved. If a subscription agreement has already detailed the main contents of the sales contract and the developer has also collected housing payments, the court will treat it as a formal sales contract, in which case it is no longer deemed "failed to conclude." If the developer refuses to refund the money, you need to file a lawsuit in court. First-instance ordinary procedure is required by regulation to conclude within 6 months, which can be extended; simplified procedure takes 3 months; attorney fees are generally borne by yourself.

entries.title: Before signing a new home contract, check clearly how floor area discrepancy is handled, and photograph and preserve promises made in brochures, advertisements, and scale models
entries.cost: Costs no money. Read two extra clauses before signing, and conveniently take photos and screenshots.
entries.summary: Unless otherwise agreed in the contract, if the registered area upon delivery differs from the contract by within 3%, the settlement is based on the actual difference with refunds for excess or supplementary payments for shortfalls. If the difference exceeds 3%, you can cancel the purchase, and the developer must refund the money plus interest within 30 days. Promises in advertisements that are specific regarding the residential complex's homes and supporting facilities and influence your decision to purchase count as binding even if not written into the contract.
entries.benefit: Regulations of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development explicitly state that where pricing is based on area, the contract must clearly specify how to handle area discrepancies. If the contract does not specify, it is handled according to the following provisions. "Where the absolute value of the area discrepancy ratio is within 3% (inclusive of 3%), the purchase price shall be settled according to the actual facts." Where it exceeds 3%, you have the right to cancel the purchase. If you cancel the purchase, the developer must refund the home purchase funds already paid within 30 days from the date of your request, while also paying interest. If you do not cancel the purchase and the registered area is larger than that in the contract, you pay supplementary funds for the portion within 3%; the portion exceeding 3% is borne by the developer, and the property title belongs to you. If the registered area is smaller than that in the contract, the developer refunds you for the portion within 3%, and refunds you double for the portion exceeding 3%. Regarding advertisements, the judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court explicitly states: sales advertisements and promotional materials are generally only invitations to negotiate and do not constitute a contract. However, where statements and promises made by the developer regarding houses and supporting facilities within the scope of the development planning are specific and definite, and have a major influence on whether you enter into the contract and on the housing price, they shall constitute contract terms. "Even if such explanations and promises are not incorporated into the commodity housing sales contract, they shall still be regarded as contractual terms," and breach thereof entails liability for breach of contract.
entries.sources: Ministry of Construction (2001). Measures for the Administration of Commercial Housing Sales (Ministry of Construction Decree No. 88, Articles 18, 19, and 20). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2002/content_70143.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2020 Amendment). Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes Over Contracts for the Sale of Commodity Housing (Article 3). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>
entries.notes: The 3% rule is the default measure when the contract contains no agreement. If the contract stipulates otherwise, it is handled according to the contract, so check carefully when signing whether that clause broadens the margin. For off-plan housing priced by the entire unit (*taojia*), the contract must attach a floor plan specifying the margin of error for dimensions. The advertisement rule applies only to houses and facilities within the scope of the development planning; items outside the planning scope are not covered under this rule. When the judicial interpretation was amended in 2020, the original article on area discrepancy was deleted, and the current legal basis is this Ministry of Construction departmental regulation. If the developer refuses to acknowledge it, you need to file a lawsuit in court. First-instance ordinary procedure is required by regulation to conclude within 6 months, which can be extended; attorney fees are generally borne by yourself.

entries.title: If you encounter delayed delivery of housing or delayed issuance of title certificates by the developer when buying a new home, first send a written demand notice to preserve evidence, and then claim liquidated damages according to the contract
entries.cost: Costs no money. Draft a written demand notice, send it via courier, and retain the mailing records. If it really comes to canceling the purchase or claiming compensation, you will most likely have to litigate.
entries.summary: If the developer is late in delivering the home, first urge them in writing; if they still do not deliver within three months, you can cancel the purchase. If the contract does not specify liquidated damages, you are compensated according to the rental value of similar houses in the same neighborhood. If you cannot obtain the property title certificate due to the developer's fault, compensation is also due, and if it is delayed past the certificate-issuance deadline by more than one year, you can also cancel the purchase. The right to cancel the purchase has a time limit; do not drag on indefinitely without stating your position.
entries.benefit: The judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court explicitly states: where the developer is overdue in delivering the house, and fails to deliver within 3 months after being urged by you, you may terminate the contract, unless otherwise agreed in the contract. The right to terminate the contract has a time limit. If the developer presses you to state your position, you must decide within 3 months. If the developer does not press you, the right must be exercised within one year from the date you knew you could terminate; it lapses once overdue. Where the contract has neither agreed upon liquidated damages nor agreed upon how compensation is calculated, overdue delivery damages are calculated based on the rental value of comparable housing in the same area during the overdue period. If, due to reasons attributable to the developer, you have not obtained the real property title certificate by the following deadlines, the developer shall bear liability for breach of contract. There are three deadlines: the certificate-processing deadline agreed in the contract; 90 days from the date of housing delivery for off-plan housing; and 90 days from the date of contract signing for completed existing housing. If the contract does not agree upon liquidated damages, damages are calculated based on the total amount of home purchase funds you already paid, with reference to the overdue loan interest standard prescribed by the People's Bank of China. Where more than one year has passed after the certificate-processing deadline arrived and registration still cannot be handled due to the developer's fault, you may terminate the contract and claim damages. If agreed liquidated damages are excessively high and the developer requests a reduction, the court adjusts them using the standard of exceeding actual losses by 30%.
entries.sources: Supreme People's Court (2020 Amendment). Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes Over Contracts for the Sale of Commodity Housing (Articles 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 20, and 21). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 563). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>
entries.notes: Use written form for the demand notice, send it by express courier to the developer's address stated in the contract, and properly keep the courier waybill receipt and delivery tracking record. The judicial interpretation only states "after being urged," without prescribing the specific form; sending written notice via courier is based on the author's practical experience. If the contract stipulates liquidated damages for delivery delay, calculate according to the contract first. After canceling the purchase, the mortgage loan contract can also be terminated simultaneously. The developer must refund the loan principal to the bank and refund the purchase funds you paid along with interest to you. If the developer refuses to acknowledge it, you must sue in court. First-instance ordinary procedure is required by regulation to conclude within 6 months, which can be extended; attorney fees are generally borne by yourself.

entries.title: Before signing a contract to buy a home, check thoroughly for court attachments and mortgages; after signing, go to the real property registration authority to apply for preliminary notice registration
entries.cost: A check before signing carrying your national ID card takes half an hour. After signing, take the materials with the seller to visit the registration authority once, and pay registration fees according to local standards.
entries.summary: Before signing, bring your ID card to the real property registration authority to check whether the property has mortgages, court attachments, or has been registered in advance to someone else. Agree in the contract to handle preliminary notice registration (*yugao dengji*), and go apply immediately after signing. Once registered, if the seller resells or remortgages without your consent, the registration authority will not process it. You must process the formal title transfer within 90 days after formal transfer becomes possible; otherwise, the preliminary notice registration lapses.
entries.benefit: The Civil Code explicitly states: after signing a house purchase agreement, to ensure the realization of property rights in the future, application for preliminary notice registration may be filed with the registration agency pursuant to agreements. "After preliminary notice registration is completed, any disposal of the real property without the consent of the holder of the preliminary notice registration shall not produce property rights (*in rem*) effect." Preliminary notice registration has a validity period. Under circumstances such as termination of the contract, or where no application for formal registration is made within 90 days from the date when formal registration can be processed, the preliminary notice registration becomes invalid. The implementation rules of the Ministry of Natural Resources operationalize this with the registration authorities: both pre-sale commodity housing and second-hand house sales can be handled. During the validity period of preliminary notice registration, if the seller uses this property to apply for registration without your written consent, the registration authority will not handle it. When purchasing off-plan housing, if the developer fails to apply together with you as agreed, you can apply unilaterally. What can be checked before signing: those with a purchase intention can check whether this house has mortgages, preliminary notice registrations, objection registrations, or whether it has been sealed or attached by courts simply by presenting their ID card. Online contract registration filing (*wangqian be'an*) does not govern contract validity. The judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court explicitly states that failure to complete contract filing for a pre-sale contract does not affect contract validity, unless the parties agreed that the contract would only take effect upon filing.
entries.sources: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 221). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2024 Amendment). Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Interim Regulations on Real Estate Registration (Articles 85 and 86). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11506/202408/content_6966482.html>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2024 Amendment). Interim Measures for the Query of Real Estate Registration Materials (Article 21). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11506/202408/content_6966482.html>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2025). Decision on Amending the Interim Measures for the Query of Real Estate Registration Materials (Decree No. 18 of the Ministry of Natural Resources). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_12546/202602/content_7057456.html>; Supreme People's Court (2020 Amendment). Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes Over Contracts for the Sale of Commodity Housing (Articles 6 and 7). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>
entries.notes: For how to query before signing and what to bring, see Item 6 (Verifying Title Certificates and Mortgage Status Before Signing). Before a contract is signed, you cannot check who the property owner is; the name on the title certificate must be cross-checked in person against the seller's ID card. Handling preliminary notice registration requires prior agreement between both parties, so write it into the sales contract. If the seller maliciously colludes with another party, signs another contract, and delivers the house, you may request to confirm that contract invalid. However, this requires litigation; first-instance ordinary procedure is required by regulation to conclude within 6 months, which can be extended, and attorney fees are generally borne by yourself. Preliminary notice registration blocks this path in advance.

entries.title: If you carry a floating-rate mortgage and your interest rate is significantly higher than that of newly issued mortgages, negotiate with your bank to lower the rate or apply for refinancing replacement
entries.cost: Costs no money. Call the bank customer service hotline or apply via mobile banking, taking several tens of minutes each time. The bank does not necessarily agree.
entries.summary: Mortgage rates add basis points on top of a benchmark rate; originally, the added basis points were locked for life in the contract, but starting from 2024, you are permitted to negotiate changes with your bank. If your rate is significantly higher than that of newly issued mortgages nationwide, you can negotiate with the bank for a reduction, or apply for a newly issued loan to replace the old one. On a 1,000,000 yuan, 30-year loan, a half-percentage-point lower interest rate saves approximately 100,000 yuan in interest.
entries.benefit: A 2024 announcement by the People's Bank of China permits borrowers and lenders to negotiate adjustments to the basis point addition spread of mortgage rates based on the LPR. The LPR is the Loan Prime Rate, and mortgage rates add or subtract basis points relative to it. An official of the People's Bank of China stated in a press briefing that the basis point spread in original contracts used to be fixed throughout the entire loan term, but this has now been reformed. In August 2026, the People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration further codified into regulations: for already-issued floating-rate personal housing mortgages, when the rate deviates by a certain margin from the interest rate of newly issued mortgages nationwide, "borrowers may negotiate with banking financial institutions to change the interest rate level agreed in the contract, or apply for newly issued floating-rate personal housing loans to replace existing stock loans, with the method to be chosen independently by the borrower." The amount of the new loan shall not exceed the remaining principal of the original loan. As for how much can be saved, the following is an example calculated by the author using the equal principal and interest repayment formula. For a loan of 1,000,000 CNY over 30 years, when the annual interest rate is 4.0%, the monthly payment is approximately 4,774 yuan; at 3.5%, it is approximately 4,490 yuan. It saves about 284 yuan each month, and saves approximately 100,000 yuan in interest payments over 30 years.
entries.sources: People's Bank of China, National Financial Regulatory Administration (2026).
