chapters.title: Pregnancy and Childbirth: From Discovering Pregnancy to Discharge and Certificate Processing
chapters.intro:
The first half of this section calculates the mortality risks for pregnant women and fetuses. The second half calculates money and running-around time. The two types of ledger are not converted into one another. The content focuses solely on "what to do when." Matters without solid evidence or with very minor effects, such as prenatal nutrition and fetal education, are not covered here. For the financial ledgers of maternity allowances, maternity leave, and raising children, see Section 18; for how to care for a child after birth, see Section 20; for emergency conditions, see Section 13.

Numbers provided by the World Health Organization: in 2023, approximately 260,000 women worldwide died from pregnancy and childbirth. About 75% of them died from these five categories of causes: severe postpartum hemorrhage, infections, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (a class of diseases where blood pressure rises after pregnancy, including preeclampsia and eclampsia), complications during labor and delivery, and unsafe abortions. The World Health Organization also states that "most maternal deaths are preventable, as the health-care solutions to prevent or manage complications are well known." The most impactful items in this section serve precisely to intercept these types of problems in advance.

The items in this section are divided by theme into the following blocks, with item numbers in parentheses.

**Things you can do yourself before and during pregnancy**: Supplement folic acid as soon as you prepare for pregnancy (Item 1), not a single cigarette or sip of alcohol (Item 4), no need to send the cat away (Item 17), inactivated influenza vaccine (Item 18), sleep on your side after 28 weeks (Item 19).

**Prenatal checks and screening**: Establish the Maternal and Child Health Handbook (Item 2), the trio of tests for HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B (Item 3), low-dose aspirin (Item 5), gestational diabetes screening (Item 6).

**Go to the hospital immediately if something goes wrong**: The "go to the hospital immediately" checklist (Item 7), lie flat on the spot if water breaks (Item 8).

**During childbirth**: Say so directly if you want labor analgesia (Item 9), do not proactively request a cesarean section (Item 10).

**After childbirth**: The postpartum 42-day follow-up check (Item 16), breastfeeding does not equal contraception (Item 20).

**Money and certificates**: Confirm maternity insurance (Item 11), Medical Birth Certificate (Item 12), heel prick screening and hearing screening (Item 13), enroll the child in resident basic medical insurance (Item 14), declare birth registration (Item 15).

entries.title: Start taking 0.4 mg of folic acid daily as soon as preparing for pregnancy, and keep taking it until completing the first 3 months of early pregnancy
entries.cost: A few dozen yuan per bottle. Rural women do not need to spend money, as the national free folic acid supplementation project distributes it. Take one tablet a day; the difficulty is remembering it every single day.
entries.summary: Taking one folic acid tablet a day around pregnancy reduces the probability of a child developing neural tube defects by approximately 70%. Neural tube defects refer to birth defects such as anencephaly and spina bifida. For someone who has already given birth to a child with such defects, the probability of another affected child drops to about one-third of the original rate.
entries.benefit: A Cochrane systematic review pooled 5 trials involving 6,708 deliveries, rating the quality of evidence as high. Daily folic acid supplementation around pregnancy reduced the risk of fetal neural tube defects to RR 0.31 (95% CI 0.17 to 0.58, credible range), a decrease of about 70%. For people who had already given birth to a child with neural tube defects, the risk of recurrence was RR 0.34 (95% CI 0.18 to 0.64), dropping to roughly one-third of the original rate. Analyzed by subgroup, there was no difference in efficacy between 0.4 mg and higher doses. Nor was there any difference in efficacy between taking folic acid alone and taking multivitamins. The 2010 management plan for the folic acid supplementation project by the Ministry of Health clearly stipulated that free folic acid is distributed to rural women preparing for pregnancy, to be "taken from 3 months before pregnancy to 3 months into early pregnancy," distributing 0.4 mg folic acid tablets. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention states that neural tube defects occur in the first few weeks of pregnancy, often before you even know you are pregnant.
entries.sources: De-Regil LM, Peña-Rosas JP, Fernández-Gaxiola AC, Rayco-Solon P (2015). Effects and safety of periconceptional oral folate supplementation for preventing birth defects. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, (12), CD007950. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD007950.pub3> ; General Office of the Ministry of Health (2010). Management Plan for the 2010 Folic Acid Supplementation Project to Prevent Neural Tube Defects. <https://www.nhc.gov.cn/wjw/gfxwj/201006/22a0b4d4651e4b6d896453d443d9f79d/files/1733384846754_72260.doc> ; Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. About Folic Acid. <https://www.cdc.gov/folic-acid/about/index.html>
entries.notes: The key is "start taking it before pregnancy." Neural tube defects occur during the first few weeks of pregnancy; by the time you test positive for pregnancy, taking it might already be too late. Therefore, if you intend to have a child, start taking it 3 months in advance following the domestic program's protocol. In the same pooled study, folic acid showed no clear effect on cleft lip and palate, congenital heart disease, or miscarriage; do not expect it to treat other conditions. Strictly vegan pregnant women also need daily vitamin B12 supplementation; see Section 20, Item 14 (supplement vitamin B12 daily if eating vegan). For those still hesitating about when to give birth, see the age calculation in Section 18, Item 7 (having children a few years later).

entries.title: Set up the Maternal and Child Health Handbook at a community health service center before 13 weeks of pregnancy, and use up the free prenatal examination quota
entries.cost: Costs no money; this belongs to the National Basic Public Health Services Program. Requires several trips according to gestational weeks.
entries.summary: At least five prenatal examinations during pregnancy, along with postpartum home visits and the 42-day postpartum checkup, are funded by the state. The way to claim them is to set up a Maternal and Child Health Handbook at the community level before 13 weeks of pregnancy. If you don't set it up, these free visits will simply be missed.
entries.benefit: The National Basic Public Health Service Specifications (Third Edition) includes maternal health management services. Permanent resident pregnant and postpartum women within the jurisdiction are entitled to the following: 1 early pregnancy health examination, 2 mid-pregnancy examinations, 2 late-pregnancy examinations, 1 postpartum home visit, and 1 health examination at 42 days postpartum. One must go to establish the handbook before 13 weeks of pregnancy, and receive the 1st prenatal examination at the same time. The two mid-pregnancy examinations are at 16–20 weeks and 21–24 weeks of pregnancy, respectively. The two late-pregnancy examinations are at 28–36 weeks and 37–40 weeks of pregnancy, respectively. Publicly disclosed local service lists also include a complete set of lab tests at the first visit and postpartum depression screening.
entries.sources: National Health and Family Planning Commission (2017). National Basic Public Health Service Specifications (Third Edition). <https://www.nhc.gov.cn/ewebeditor/uploadfile/2017/04/20170417104506514.pdf> ; Jingjiang Municipal People's Government. National Basic Public Health Service Project—Maternal Health Management Services (Public Disclosure of Local Service Catalog). <https://www.jingjiang.gov.cn/xxgk/zdlyxxgk/wsjk/art/2023/art_383017a2e7794892bc772bfbe042f379.html>
entries.notes: These 5 visits are the minimum baseline of what is free, not the entirety of prenatal care. Hospitals will add ultrasound scans, blood glucose testing, and fetal heart rate monitoring according to the situation, which require out-of-pocket payment. The earlier the handbook is established, the earlier pregnancy risk grading can be completed. Pregnancy risk grading categorizes pregnant women into tiers based on risk levels; only if someone is identified as high-risk can they be referred early to a hospital capable of handling the case. Those living outside their registered district can establish the handbook where they currently reside, without returning to their household registration (hukou) location.

entries.title: Screen for HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B at the very first prenatal check; free transmission blocking is available even if HIV is detected
entries.cost: HIV counseling and preliminary screening tests are free under regulations. For syphilis and hepatitis B, national documents do not state they are free; inquire with your prenatal checkup hospital about whether fees are charged.
entries.summary: Screen for HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B at the first prenatal checkup. Preliminary screening for HIV does not require paying out of pocket. Even if a test comes back positive, it is not a dead end. If HIV is detected, the state provides treatment and counseling free of charge. If syphilis is detected, treat it as early as possible with penicillin. If hepatitis B is detected, administer both the vaccine and immunoglobulin as soon as the baby is born to block transmission from mother to child.
entries.benefit: Mother-to-child transmission means the disease passes from the mother to the child. The Work Specifications for the Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission of HIV, Syphilis, and Hepatitis B (2020 Edition) sets out requirements. At the first prenatal examination, the hospital must communicate relevant information, "provide appropriate, standardized testing, and provide follow-up counseling based on results." If status remains unclarified prior to delivery, the case is handled in principle as an infection. The specifications require "standardized penicillin treatment as early as possible" for pregnant and lying-in women diagnosed with syphilis, with preventive penicillin treatment administered immediately after the baby is born. For pregnant and lying-in women who test positive for hepatitis B surface antigen, antiviral therapy is given after informed consent if criteria are met. Testing positive is not a dead end. Article 23 of the Regulations on the Prevention and Control of HIV/AIDS stipulates that "free counseling and preliminary screening tests" shall be provided to individuals voluntarily undergoing HIV counseling and testing. Article 44 stipulates that "free treatment and counseling for the prevention of mother-to-child transmission of HIV" shall be provided to HIV-infected pregnant and postpartum women. Article 43 mandates the provision of services such as blocking transmission (preventing the disease from passing to the child), treatment, postpartum home visits, infant follow-up, and testing. If the mother is positive for hepatitis B surface antigen, the newborn must receive both the hepatitis B vaccine and hepatitis B immunoglobulin at birth (see Section 20, Item 2).
entries.sources: General Office of the National Health Commission (2020). Work Specifications for the Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission of HIV, Syphilis, and Hepatitis B (2020 Edition). <https://wjw.xinjiang.gov.cn/hfpc/zhgl6/202012/08b7de496f0b40e586d4b99d00cf79c4.shtml> (reprinted by Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Health Commission) ; State Council (2006). Regulations on the Prevention and Control of HIV/AIDS (Articles 23, 43, 44). <https://wjw.beijing.gov.cn/zwgk_20040/zcwj2022/flfg/202304/t20230408_2992986.html> (reprinted by Beijing Municipal Health Commission)
entries.notes: The earlier these three items are checked, the more useful it is, because both transmission blocking and treatment take time. Article 3 of the Regulations on the Prevention and Control of HIV/AIDS also explicitly specifies that "no unit or individual may discriminate against people living with HIV, AIDS patients, or their family members," and lawful rights and interests regarding marriage, employment, medical treatment, and education are protected by law. For routine prevention and testing, see Section 1. For post-exposure prophylaxis following high-risk behavior, see Section 13.

entries.title: Not a single cigarette or sip of alcohol throughout pregnancy; family members should also refrain from smoking indoors
entries.cost: Costs nothing and saves money on tobacco and alcohol. The difficulty is getting cohabiting family members to quit along with you.
entries.summary: Smoking during pregnancy drives up the probability of premature birth, low birth weight, and cleft lip or palate, and doubles the risk of abnormal bleeding during pregnancy and delivery. A mother smoking during pregnancy, or an infant inhaling smoke after birth, both increase the risk of sudden infant death syndrome. It is never too late to quit.
entries.benefit: The stance of the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention: smoking during pregnancy can cause babies to "be born too small, even after a full-term pregnancy" and "can cause a baby to be born too early." It "doubles your risk of abnormal bleeding during pregnancy and delivery." It increases the risk of birth defects such as cleft lip and cleft palate. It also "damages your baby's developing lungs and brain, and the damage can last through childhood." Babies born to mothers who smoke during pregnancy, as well as babies exposed to smoke after birth, face a higher risk of Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS). The official recommendation is that "it is best to quit smoking before you get pregnant, but if you're already pregnant, quitting can still help" and "it's never too late to quit." Regarding alcohol, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention states that "there is no known safe amount of alcohol use during pregnancy," nor is there any time during pregnancy when drinking is safe. A baby's brain develops throughout the entire pregnancy, and exposure to alcohol at any time can affect it.
entries.sources: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Smoking During Pregnancy. <https://www.cdc.gov/tobacco/campaign/tips/diseases/pregnancy.html>；Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. About Alcohol Use During Pregnancy. <https://www.cdc.gov/alcohol-pregnancy/about/index.html>
entries.notes: When others smoke indoors, the second-hand smoke inhaled by a pregnant woman affects the fetus just the same. Therefore, cohabiting family members must not smoke indoors either. The same goes for alcohol: there is no known safe drinking amount, and the simplest course of action during pregnancy is not to drink a single sip. For the impact of tobacco and alcohol on adults themselves, see Section 2.

entries.title: Those with high-risk factors for preeclampsia should start taking one tablet of low-dose aspirin daily as prescribed by a doctor after 12 weeks of pregnancy
entries.cost: A few dozen yuan. Take medication daily according to medical advice, continuing all the way until delivery. The difficulty is remembering it every day.
entries.summary: Preeclampsia is a type of hypertensive disorder during pregnancy. People who had it in a previous pregnancy, are carrying multiples, have chronic hypertension, had diabetes before pregnancy, or have kidney disease or autoimmune diseases are considered high-risk. For high-risk individuals taking low-dose aspirin daily under medical advice starting at 12 weeks of pregnancy, preeclampsia decreases by about 15%, and preterm birth and perinatal infant mortality decrease by about 20%. Others should not take it on their own.
entries.benefit: The U.S. Preventive Services Task Force gives a Grade B recommendation: for people at high risk of preeclampsia, start taking low-dose aspirin (81 mg/day) after 12 weeks of gestation for prevention. Preeclampsia is a type of hypertensive disorder in pregnancy. Combining multiple studies, the results are as follows, where 95% CI is the confidence interval: Preeclampsia RR 0.85 (95% CI 0.75 to 0.95, 16 studies), approximately 15% lower. Preterm birth RR 0.80 (95% CI 0.67 to 0.95, 13 studies), approximately 20% lower. Perinatal mortality RR 0.79 (95% CI 0.66 to 0.96, 11 studies), approximately 21% lower; perinatal mortality refers to death occurring in the period around birth. Small for gestational age / intrauterine growth restriction RR 0.82 (95% CI 0.68 to 0.99, 16 studies), approximately 18% lower; this refers to the fetus growing smaller than expected for the gestational age.
entries.sources: US Preventive Services Task Force (2021). Aspirin Use to Prevent Preeclampsia and Related Morbidity and Mortality: Preventive Medication. <https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/low-dose-aspirin-use-for-the-prevention-of-morbidity-and-mortality-from-preeclampsia-preventive-medication>
entries.notes: Those considered high-risk include: having had preeclampsia in a previous pregnancy, being pregnant with twins or multiples, and having chronic hypertension. In addition, having type 1 or type 2 diabetes before pregnancy, having kidney disease, and having autoimmune diseases such as systemic lupus erythematosus or antiphospholipid syndrome. Those not in these categories should not take it on their own. This medication requires a doctor's prescription; explain your medical history clearly during prenatal checkups and let the doctor decide. Most products sold domestically are 100 mg enteric-coated tablets; take them as directed by your doctor.

entries.title: Screen for gestational diabetes at or after 24 weeks of pregnancy; do not skip it just because drinking the glucose solution is troublesome
entries.cost: Several tens to over one hundred yuan. Requires going on an empty stomach, multiple blood draws, and takes up half a morning.
entries.summary: Gestational diabetes is elevated blood sugar that only appears after becoming pregnant. Spending half a morning after 24 weeks of pregnancy to drink the glucose solution once and have blood drawn a few times can detect it. If left unscreened and unmanaged, the risks of macrosomia, difficult labor, cesarean delivery, preeclampsia, and neonatal hypoglycemia will all rise.
entries.benefit: The Grade B recommendation from the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force: screen for gestational diabetes mellitus at or after 24 weeks of pregnancy in asymptomatic pregnant women (those who do not feel any discomfort themselves). Gestational diabetes is elevated blood sugar that only appears after becoming pregnant. If screening is done only once, it should be scheduled at or after 24 weeks of pregnancy. Regarding whether screening before 24 weeks of pregnancy is beneficial, the Task Force concluded that the current evidence is insufficient to assess the balance of benefits and harms (Grade I). If left unmanaged, gestational diabetes increases the risks of the following: macrosomia (the fetus growing excessively large), difficult labor, cesarean section, preeclampsia, and neonatal hypoglycemia.
entries.sources: US Preventive Services Task Force (2021). Gestational Diabetes: Screening. <https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/gestational-diabetes-screening>；Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Gestational Diabetes. <https://www.cdc.gov/diabetes/about/gestational-diabetes.html>
entries.notes: According to the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force, once detected, management generally begins with exercise, dietary adjustments, and blood sugar monitoring; insulin or oral medications are only used if blood sugar cannot be controlled. Do not skip this screening out of fear that being diagnosed will require injections. Blood sugar must also be rechecked after giving birth: the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention states that about half of people who had gestational diabetes go on to develop type 2 diabetes later in life.

entries.title: Memorize this "go to the hospital immediately" list; it applies throughout pregnancy and for one year postpartum
entries.cost: Costs nothing. Takes five minutes to memorize; ideally, let the people living with you know it as well.
entries.summary: If any of the following symptoms appear, go to the hospital that very day; do not wait at home overnight, and this applies for up to one year postpartum as well: A headache that won't go away or keeps getting worse, changes in vision, fever reaching 38 °C, severe swelling of the hands or face. Shortness of breath, chest pain or rapid heartbeat, severe abdominal pain that does not ease, fetal movements stopping or noticeably decreasing. Vaginal bleeding or fluid leaking, severe swelling and pain in an arm or leg, thoughts of hurting yourself or your baby.
entries.benefit: The urgent maternal warning signs listed by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention include the following: headaches that persist or get progressively worse, dizziness or fainting, changes in vision, body temperature reaching 38 °C or higher; severe swelling of the hands or face, thoughts of hurting yourself or your baby, difficulty breathing, chest pain or rapid heartbeat; severe nausea and vomiting, severe abdominal pain that does not ease, fetal movements stopping or noticeably decreasing during pregnancy; vaginal bleeding or leaking of fluid during pregnancy, abnormal vaginal bleeding or discharge postpartum; severe swelling, redness, or pain in an arm or a leg. These issues can occur anytime within one year postpartum; it is not the case that "everything is fine once the month of confinement is over."
entries.sources: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Hear Her — Urgent Maternal Warning Signs. <https://www.cdc.gov/hearher/maternal-warning-signs/index.html>；World Health Organization. Maternal mortality fact sheet. <https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/maternal-mortality>
entries.notes: The purpose of this list is to separate "toughing it out a bit longer" from "having to leave immediately." A headache combined with blurred vision and upper abdominal pain points toward preeclampsia (a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy). Swelling and pain in one calf points toward deep vein thrombosis (see Section 13). According to the World Health Organization, postpartum hemorrhage can take the life of a healthy woman within hours. If any single symptom appears, go directly to the hospital; do not wait at home overnight first.

entries.title: If your water breaks, lie flat on the spot, elevate your hips, and call 120; do not walk around and do not take a shower
entries.cost: Costs nothing.
entries.summary: When your water breaks, do not take your time packing belongings before heading out. The correct procedure is to lie down right where you are, elevate your buttocks, and call 120. Walking while standing makes amniotic fluid flow out faster, and the umbilical cord may be washed down with it. That is a life-threatening emergency for the baby.
entries.benefit: Management instructions provided by the Beijing Municipal Health Commission: upon discovering that water has broken, "immediately find a place to lie flat to prevent amniotic fluid from leaking out," "do not walk around casually," and "call the 120 emergency telephone number immediately." While waiting for the ambulance, notify family members to bring belongings and meet at the hospital. Popular science from medical institutions further explains why: when a person stands, amniotic fluid is lost faster, and the fetus's umbilical cord may prolapse along with it; this is called umbilical cord prolapse, a life-threatening emergency for the fetus. Therefore, you must lie down, elevate your hips, and you may adopt a left lateral position.
entries.sources: Beijing Municipal Health Commission. Weekly First Aid Topic: What Should Expectant Mothers Do When Amniotic Fluid Breaks Prematurely? <https://wjw.beijing.gov.cn/bmfw_20143/jkzs/jzjj/202001/t20200115_1575632.html>; Shunyi District Maternal and Child Health Hospital of Beijing. What to Do If Your Water Breaks at Home in Late Pregnancy? <https://www.bch-syfy.cn/Html/News/Articles/9453.html>
entries.notes: The three signs of impending labor are regular contractions, "bloody show," and rupture of membranes (water breaking); water breaking is the one that requires "lying down on the spot and calling an ambulance." This is summarized by the author based on the two popular science materials above. Popular science from the Shunyi District Maternal and Child Health Hospital states that getting out of bed to stand, walking around, sitting, or squatting will all cause amniotic fluid to drain faster and increase the risk of umbilical cord prolapse. Therefore, after your water breaks, do not take a bath or shower, do not squat on the toilet, and do not drive yourself. Note the time the water broke and the color of the amniotic fluid, and tell your doctor. If the amniotic fluid is light green, yellow-green, or even brownish-yellow, it indicates that it may be mixed with meconium (fetal feces). If you feel a cord-like object hanging down in the vagina, it may be umbilical cord prolapse; call 120 immediately, lie flat, and elevate your hips. If fetal movements are noticeably different from usual, inform the doctor as well.

entries.title: If you want painless childbirth, ask for it directly; it does not increase the risk of cesarean section
entries.cost: Several hundred to over one thousand yuan, with prices varying by region. You need to ask the hospital and anesthesiology department in advance whether it is offered. The hard part is bringing it up yourself.
entries.summary: Painless childbirth means administering an anesthetic into the lower back to suppress the pain of labor. It is more effective than other pain relief methods and does not make you more likely to undergo a cesarean section. The claim that "getting an epidural gives you a lifetime of back pain" is likewise unfounded. It now has its own standalone billing item, designed to make hospitals more willing to offer it.
entries.benefit: The conclusion of a Cochrane systematic review is that epidural analgesia is more effective in reducing labor pain and improving maternal satisfaction with pain relief compared with non-epidural methods. Painless childbirth uses epidural analgesia. The same review also stated that "epidural analgesia had no impact on the risk of caesarean section or long-term backache." The phenomenon of increased instrumental delivery (delivering the baby with instruments) is no longer seen in studies conducted after 2005. Starting in 2024, the National Healthcare Security Administration's guidelines for setting up pricing items for obstetric medical services established separate items for "labor analgesia," "doula delivery," and "family-accompanied delivery." The rationale was precisely that previously, without standalone pricing items, hospitals' motivation to provide labor analgesia was dampened.
entries.sources: Anim-Somuah M, Smyth RMD, Cyna AM, Cuthbert A (2018). Epidural versus non-epidural or no analgesia for pain management in labour. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, (5), CD000331. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD000331.pub4>; National Healthcare Security Administration (2024). Restructuring Obstetric Service Pricing Items to Help Build a Fertility-Friendly Society. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202406/content_6957553.htm>
entries.notes: The two most widespread claims—"getting an epidural causes back pain for a lifetime" and "getting an epidural leads to difficult labor requiring a cesarean"—are both without evidence. Cochrane pooled epidural analgesia with other pain-relief methods and concluded that it has no impact on either cesarean section risk or long-term backache. The real side effects are: low blood pressure, fever, weak legs, urinary retention, as well as prolonged first and second stages of labor, and a higher likelihood of requiring oxytocin. Whether to use it is up to you, but do not give it up based on rumors. Whether it is available also depends on whether the hospital has an anesthesiologist on duty 24 hours a day; ask clearly during your prenatal checkups.

entries.title: Do not actively request a cesarean section without medical indications, and do not undergo surgery just to pick an auspicious date
entries.cost: Costs nothing. The difficulty lies in resisting family members' opinions.
entries.summary: According to the World Health Organization, once the cesarean section rate in a region exceeds 10%, there is no evidence showing that maternal and neonatal mortality continues to decline. Those who need a cesarean must have one. Having a cesarean to pick an auspicious date or out of fear of pain means undergoing an extra major abdominal surgery.
entries.benefit: A 2015 statement by the World Health Organization: when cesarean section rates rise towards approximately 10% across a population, maternal and neonatal deaths decrease. Beyond 10%, there is no evidence that mortality rates improve any further. At the same time, the World Health Organization emphasized that every effort should be made to provide cesarean sections to women in need, rather than striving to achieve a specific rate.
entries.sources: World Health Organization (2015). WHO Statement on Caesarean Section Rates（WHO/RHR/15.02）. <https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/WHO-RHR-15.02>；Keag OE, Norman JE, Stock SJ (2018). Long-term risks and benefits associated with cesarean delivery for mother, baby, and subsequent pregnancies: Systematic review and meta-analysis. PLoS Medicine, 15(1), e1002494. <https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pmed.1002494>
entries.notes: When medically necessary, a cesarean section is a lifesaving operation—have it done when needed, and do not tough it out stubbornly. What should be avoided is undergoing surgery when it is not medically necessary, such as out of fear of pain, picking an auspicious hour, or calculating the child's school-enrollment age cutoff. A cesarean section is major abdominal surgery. A pooled analysis comparing cesarean sections with vaginal deliveries found that in subsequent pregnancies after a cesarean section, placenta previa had an OR of 1.74, roughly 70% higher. Placenta accreta had an OR of 2.95, about 3 times as high. Placental abruption had an OR of 1.38, and stillbirth had an OR of 1.27. This directly impacts whether you might want a second child. Conversely, people who have cesarean sections experience less urinary leakage and pelvic organ prolapse later on. These findings all come from observational follow-up studies, and the authors state that one cannot definitively conclude based on this that cesarean section is the cause.

entries.title: Confirm maternity insurance enrollment status before pregnancy; unemployed spouses can also have maternity medical expenses reimbursed
entries.cost: Costs nothing. Make a single inquiry call to social security or healthcare security.
entries.summary: If an employer pays maternity insurance contributions, the medical expenses for childbirth and the allowance during maternity leave are both paid out of this fund. If a spouse is unemployed, the medical expenses portion can also be reimbursed. You need to ask in advance whether the number of insured months is sufficient and whether prior filing is required when giving birth in another locality.
entries.benefit: Article 54 of the Social Insurance Law: Where an employer has paid maternity insurance premiums, its employees shall enjoy maternity insurance benefits. Unemployed spouses of employees shall enjoy maternity medical expense benefits in accordance with national regulations, and the necessary funds shall be paid from the maternity insurance fund. When an employer pays maternity insurance, the employee themselves is entitled to benefits, and the childbirth medical expenses of the employee's unemployed spouse can also be paid from this fund. Maternity insurance benefits are divided into two parts: one is maternity medical expenses, which are the medical expenses for childbirth itself; the other is the maternity allowance, which is the money paid to you during maternity leave. Article 56 specifies three circumstances under which maternity allowances can be received: female employees taking maternity leave for childbirth, taking leave for family planning surgeries, and other circumstances prescribed by laws and regulations. The maternity allowance "shall be calculated and paid according to the average monthly wage of the employees of the employer in the preceding year," calculated based on the previous year's average monthly wage of employees at your employer, not your own personal wage.
entries.sources: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2010). Social Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China (Articles 54, 56). <https://guangdong.chinatax.gov.cn/gdsw/qysw_gkwj/2020-02/12/content_8e8c485d0db34b989531f3ba57cec5a9.shtml> (reprinted by Guangdong Provincial Tax Service, State Taxation Administration)
entries.notes: Two matters should be inquired about with the local healthcare security department in advance. First, whether the number of consecutive months of insurance participation is sufficient and whether there is a minimum months requirement. Second, if giving birth outside the place of insurance registration, whether prior filing for cross-locality childbirth registration is required, and how expenses without prior filing are reimbursed. These two rules vary from place to place; they have not been verified locality by locality here, and inquiring in advance is the author's advice. For how to calculate the number of maternity leave days and the maternity allowance, see Section 18, Item 2.

entries.title: Obtain the Medical Birth Certificate before discharge; decide on the name in advance and do not write the wrong characters
entries.cost: Costs nothing. Can be done conveniently while handling discharge procedures.
entries.summary: This certificate is a prerequisite for household registration, health insurance enrollment, and schooling. For births in a hospital, obtain it from the institution that handled the delivery. For births outside midwifery institutions, a paternity/maternity test must be completed before it can be obtained. For characters used in the name, confirm in advance that the household registration system can type them out.
entries.benefit: Article 23 of the Maternal and Infant Health Care Law: Medical and healthcare institutions and personnel engaged in home delivery shall issue a uniformly formulated Medical Birth Certificate for newborns in accordance with the regulations of the health administrative department under the State Council. This certificate is a prerequisite for everything that follows: household registration (hukou), social insurance enrollment, obtaining a medical insurance card, kindergarten admission, and school enrollment all require it. The 2015 opinions of the General Office of the State Council on resolving household registration issues for unregistered persons specify: for births within midwifery institutions, apply for the Medical Birth Certificate from that midwifery institution. For births outside midwifery institutions, one must first obtain a parentage testing certificate issued by a qualified identification agency, and then apply to an institution authorized by the county-level health department.
entries.sources: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (1994, amended 2017). Maternal and Infant Health Care Law of the People's Republic of China (Article 23). <https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2021-10/29/content_5647619.htm>; General Office of the State Council (2015). Opinions on Resolving the Issue of Household Registration for Persons Without Registered Hukou (Guobanfa [2015] No. 96). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2016-01/14/content_10595.htm>
entries.notes: Before filling it out, verify the parents' names, ID numbers, and child's name character by character. The characters used for the name must be typable in the household registration system; rare or obscure characters will cause a lot of trouble for future administrative procedures. Changing a name and amending the certificate requires going through replacement or reissuance procedures, which is far more troublesome than verifying on the spot. Once you receive the certificate, store it separately; it is just as important as the household register (hukou book) and identity card.

entries.title: Do not refuse newborn heel prick screening or hearing screening
entries.cost: Free in most areas, or several tens of yuan. Some expanded tests must be paid out of pocket. A single heel prick after the baby is born.
entries.summary: A single heel-prick blood test and a hearing test can detect hypothyroidism, phenylketonuria, and hearing impairments while the baby appears completely normal. By the time symptoms become apparent, the intellectual damage is already irreversible.
entries.benefit: Article 3 of the Measures for the Administration of Newborn Disease Screening: "Nationwide diseases screened in newborn disease screening include neonatal inborn errors of metabolism such as congenital hypothyroidism and phenylketonuria, as well as hearing impairment." These two categories of disorders share a common feature: in the early stages, no abnormalities can be seen at all, but by the time symptoms are obvious, intellectual impairment has already become irreversible. Early detection and early intervention are very effective, using methods such as thyroxine supplementation, special formula milk, wearing hearing aids, or cochlear implants. Article 10 stipulates that if a screening result is positive, the institution shall promptly notify the guardian to seek a definitive diagnosis.
entries.sources: Ministry of Health (2009). Measures for the Administration of Newborn Disease Screening (Ministry of Health Order No. 64, Articles 3, 10, 11). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2009/content_1371363.htm>
entries.notes: Article 11 of the Measures requires that before screening, the items, conditions, methods, sensitivity (how many cases can be detected), and costs must be truthfully disclosed to the guardian, with written consent obtained. Therefore, you will receive an informed consent form. Read it carefully before signing: note which diseases are nationally mandated and which are optional self-paid additions. A positive initial screen does not equal a confirmed diagnosis; according to Article 10 of the Measures, the institution will notify you to bring the child in for a definitive diagnosis, so do not panic at this stage. Those who do not pass the initial hearing screening should go for rescreening as notified; do not judge for yourself that "the baby can hear, so never mind."

entries.title: Enroll your baby in resident basic medical insurance as soon as you get the Medical Birth Certificate; do not wait until household registration is completed
entries.cost: Resident medical insurance premium is paid once a year, several hundred yuan.
entries.summary: Once you obtain the birth certificate, you can enroll your baby online without waiting for household registration. Once enrolled, hospitalization expenses upon discharge can be reimbursed on the spot. Newborn hospitalization costs are not low, and there is a big difference between having insurance and not having it.
entries.benefit: The official stance of www.gov.cn in 2024: "Newborns can enroll online with their Medical Birth Certificate," without needing household registration first. "Medical expenses can be reimbursed directly after the newborn is discharged." The previous practice was that insurance enrollment was only possible after completing household registration, requiring hospitalization expenses to be paid in full out of pocket first and reimbursed afterward. The average processing time for enrollment and payment was also compressed from 28.7 working days at the beginning of the year to 6.4 working days.
entries.sources: www.gov.cn (2024). State Council Policy Routine Briefing on Improving the Long-term Mechanism for Basic Medical Insurance Enrollment. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202409/content_6973567.htm>
entries.notes: Preterm birth, phototherapy for jaundice, and neonatal pneumonia are common reasons for newborn hospitalization, easily costing tens of thousands of yuan; having insurance makes a huge difference compared to not having it. Local rules on "enrolling within how many days after birth allows one to enjoy benefits starting from the day of birth" are not completely identical. For specific implementation, what the local healthcare security department says shall prevail. Calling 12393 before discharge to ask is the most hassle-free approach.

entries.title: Declare birth registration at the local police station within one month of the child's birth
entries.cost: Costs nothing. One trip to the household registration window at the local police station.
entries.summary: Birth registration must be declared within one month of birth, and an immunization certificate must also be obtained at the birth hospital or the vaccination clinic in the place of residence. The two matters are handled separately; even without household registration, vaccinations must still be given on schedule and cannot wait until household registration is completed.
entries.benefit: Article 7 of the Regulations on Household Registration: "Within one month after the birth of an infant, the head of household, relatives, foster parents, or neighbors shall declare birth registration to the household registration authority of the infant's place of permanent residence." This is a legally prescribed time limit, not a recommendation. Household registration and vaccination are handled separately. The Vaccine Administration Law requires that within one month after a child is born, an immunization certificate must be obtained from the vaccination clinic in the place of residence or the birth hospital. These entities may not refuse to issue it. Vaccination management is based on place of residence and does not require prior household registration. Even if the child does not have household registration, vaccinations must still be administered in a timely manner according to the immunization schedule.
entries.sources: State Council (1958). Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Household Registration (Article 7). <http://www.gd.gov.cn/zwgk/wjk/zcfgk/content/post_2531969.html> (reprinted by People's Government of Guangdong Province); General Office of the State Council (2015). Opinions on Resolving the Issue of Household Registration for Persons Without Registered Hukou (Guobanfa [2015] No. 96). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2016-01/14/content_10595.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2019). Vaccine Administration Law of the People's Republic of China (Articles 6, 47). <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/fgs/art/2023/art_dde03480953841a5912c864dc29003d0.html>
entries.notes: Bring all of the following: Medical Certificate of Birth, the parents' ID cards and household registration books (hukou), and marriage certificate; refer to the specific list of requirements from your local police station. The General Office of the State Council's 2015 Opinions explicitly stated that household registration follows the principle of "voluntary registration with either the father or the mother," meaning you can choose whether to register the child under the father's or the mother's household. School districts and medical insurance locations may differ between the two sides, so think it through before going, as making changes later is troublesome. Children born out of wedlock can register their household in the same way: the same Opinions explicitly state that one can apply with the Medical Certificate of Birth, the household registration book of one parent, and a statement of non-marital birth. For registration under the father, a paternity test certificate issued by a qualified identification institution must also be submitted.

entries.title: Do not skip the 42-day postpartum checkup; in some places, it also serves as a postpartum depression screening
entries.cost: Free of charge; belongs to basic public health services. Takes half a day. The hard part is being reluctant to move around right after finishing the postpartum confinement month.
entries.summary: This checkup is free of charge. According to publicly available local service catalogs, it includes routine blood tests, routine vaginal discharge tests, and a postpartum depression screening. Major problems can arise at any time within a year after childbirth; do not assume you are in the clear just because you have finished the postpartum confinement month.
entries.benefit: In the maternal health management section of the "National Basic Public Health Service Specification (Third Edition)," postpartum care includes 1 postpartum home visit and 1 health checkup at 42 days postpartum. In local publicly available service catalogs, this checkup includes laboratory tests (routine blood tests, routine vaginal discharge tests) and 1 postpartum depression screening. The National Health Commission's 2020 special service work plan for depression prevention and control required pilot regions to "incorporate perinatal depression screening into routine prenatal examinations and postpartum home visit processes." Therefore, whether postpartum depression can be screened alongside the checkup depends on whether the local area has implemented this. Serious complications can occur throughout the entire year following childbirth. On the "go to the hospital immediately" checklist in Item 7, "thoughts of harming yourself or harming the baby," "postpartum vaginal bleeding or abnormal discharge," and "severe pain or swelling in one limb" all fall under the postpartum period.
entries.sources: National Health and Family Planning Commission (2017). National Basic Public Health Service Specification (Third Edition). <https://www.nhc.gov.cn/ewebeditor/uploadfile/2017/04/20170417104506514.pdf>; Jingjiang Municipal People's Government. National Basic Public Health Service Project—Maternal and Child Health Management Services (Local Public Service Catalog). <https://www.jingjiang.gov.cn/xxgk/zdlyxxgk/wsjk/art/2023/art_383017a2e7794892bc772bfbe042f379.html>; General Office of the National Health Commission (2020). Circular on Exploring and Carrying out Special Services for the Prevention and Treatment of Depression and Alzheimer's Disease (Guo Wei Ban Ji Kong Han [2020] No. 726). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-09/11/content_5542555.htm>
entries.notes: Postpartum depression is not acting melodramatic, nor can it be resolved simply by family members urging you to "cheer up." It has dedicated screening questionnaires, has medical treatments, and can be recovered from. For handling suicidal ideation, see Section 1. For legal options when a child has been born and truly cannot be raised, see Section 9, Item 20. This checkup will also examine how wounds have healed, how the uterus has recovered, and whether pelvic floor function is sound. Contraceptive plans are also discussed during this visit: the absence of menstruation after childbirth does not equal an inability to get pregnant.

entries.title: No need to give away your cat when pregnant; have someone else scoop the litter daily, cook meat thoroughly, and wear gloves when handling soil
entries.cost: Free. Delegate scooping the cat litter daily to family members. If you can only scoop it yourself, buy a box of disposable gloves. The hard part is having to eat meat fully cooked—medium-rare steak and lamb cannot be eaten.
entries.summary: Toxoplasma gondii is a parasite. Catching it for the first time during pregnancy can cause miscarriage and damage the baby's eyes and brain. Keeping a cat at home does not make people more likely to get infected; there is no need to give the cat away. What needs to be guarded against even more is eating undercooked meat and handling soil without washing hands; having someone else scoop the cat litter daily is sufficient.
entries.benefit: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention states that being infected with Toxoplasma gondii for the first time shortly before or during pregnancy can transmit the infection to the fetus. Most infected babies show no symptoms at birth, but may later develop blindness or intellectual disabilities. A minority of infants are born with severe eye or brain damage. The UK National Health Service (NHS) notes that infection during pregnancy can lead to miscarriage. The Toxoplasmosis Reference Centre in Lyon, France, analyzed 603 pregnant women diagnosed with infection during pregnancy, most of whom were treated with antiparasitic medications. The overall rate of fetal transmission was 29% (95% CI 25 to 33, credible interval). About 6% of infections at 13 weeks of gestation were transmitted to the fetus, compared to about 72% at 36 weeks. The earlier the infection occurs, the more likely the baby is to develop symptoms. The risk of the infant developing early symptoms was highest for infections occurring between 24 and 30 weeks of gestation, at approximately 10%. A study across six European cities compared pregnant women who acquired a new infection during pregnancy with those who were not infected. Cat ownership had an OR of 1.0 (95% CI 0.7 to 1.5), showing no difference. Cleaning the cat litter box oneself had an OR of 1.3 (95% CI 0.8 to 2.1), a difference that may have been due to chance alone. Consuming undercooked lamb had an OR of 3.13 (95% CI 1.4 to 7.2), with the risk about three times higher than not eating it. Handling soil had an OR of 1.81 (95% CI 1.2 to 2.7), about 80% higher. In each city, 30% to 63% of infections could be attributed to undercooked or cured meat, and 6% to 17% to contact with soil. Practices recommended by the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention for pregnant women: have someone else change the cat litter if possible. If no one else can change it, wear disposable gloves and wash hands with soap and water afterward. Change cat litter daily, because Toxoplasma in cat feces takes 1 to 5 days to become infectious to humans. Do not adopt a new cat during pregnancy, and do not adopt or handle stray cats, especially kittens. Keep cats indoors, and feed them only cat food or well-cooked food, never raw meat. Science popularization materials from the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention also state that cleaning the cat litter box should ideally be handled by the expectant father, and that cats can remain at home during pregnancy if proper precautions are taken. The NHS explicitly notes that petting cats or owning cats will not cause toxoplasmosis infection.
entries.sources: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Toxoplasmosis: Risk Factors. <https://www.cdc.gov/toxoplasmosis/risk-factors/index.html>; Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Preventing Toxoplasmosis. <https://www.cdc.gov/toxoplasmosis/prevention/index.html>; NHS. Toxoplasmosis. <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/toxoplasmosis/>; Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (2025). Toxoplasma Infection During Pregnancy: Is It All to Blame on "Petting Cats"? <https://www.chinacdc.cn/jkkp/crb/qtcr/202501/t20250103_303681.html>; Cook AJ, Gilbert RE, Buffolano W, et al. (2000). Sources of toxoplasma infection in pregnant women: European multicentre case-control study. BMJ, 321(7254), 142-147. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.321.7254.142>; Dunn D, Wallon M, Peyron F, Petersen E, Peckham C, Gilbert R (1999). Mother-to-child transmission of toxoplasmosis: risk estimates for clinical counselling. Lancet, 353(9167), 1829-1833. <https://doi.org/10.1016/s0140-6736(98)08220-8>
entries.notes: Cats generally shed Toxoplasma in their feces only in the few weeks following their initial infection. Adult cats infected in the past are even less likely to shed it again. Cats kept strictly indoors and not fed raw meat also have a low chance of becoming infected. Households without cats can still catch it just the same; the sources are undercooked meat, unwashed fruits and vegetables, and soil or unboiled water contaminated with cat feces. Therefore, do the following: cook meat until completely done; wash knives, cutting boards, and hands that have touched raw meat. Rinse fruits and vegetables under running water. Wear gloves when gardening or turning soil, and wash hands afterward. The NHS also cautions against eating raw cured meats such as salami and Parma ham, and against drinking unpasteurized goat's milk. That European study did not ask in detail about raw salads and unwashed vegetables; 14% to 49% of infections had an unidentified source. Ask your prenatal care obstetrician whether to test for Toxoplasma antibodies. The evidence level is graded B because the figures on risks from cats and meat come from only a single study and were recalled retrospectively. Recommended practices originate from official agencies, and no study has calculated how many infections following them can prevent. Rating the benefit as "Medium" is based on judgment, with reasons provided in the verification notes. The benefits accrue directly to you and your baby.

entries.title: Get an inactivated influenza vaccine if flu season hits during pregnancy; it can be administered at any stage of pregnancy, but do not use the nasal spray
entries.cost: Out-of-pocket expense, several tens to over one hundred yuan per shot. One trip to a community vaccination clinic. The hard part is having to pick a product whose package insert does not list pregnancy as a contraindication.
entries.summary: Pregnant women who catch the flu are more likely to be hospitalized than non-pregnant individuals. Getting a flu shot during pregnancy reduces the mother's influenza-related hospitalization by about 40%. For the infant, confirmed flu cases in the first 6 months of life are reduced by about half, and flu hospitalizations are reduced by about 70%. Vaccination has not been shown to increase miscarriages, stillbirths, or birth defects.
entries.benefit: The World Health Organization's 2022 position paper summarized existing studies. When pregnant women contract the flu, their risk of hospitalization is about 7 times that of non-pregnant women (OR 6.8, 95% CI 6–7.7, credible interval). A trial in Bangladesh randomly allocated 340 pregnant women into two groups: one received the inactivated influenza vaccine and the other received the pneumococcal vaccine as a control, followed up to 24 weeks after the infant's birth. Among those given the flu vaccine, there were 6 confirmed flu cases in the infants compared to 16 in the control group, representing a vaccine efficacy of 63% (95% CI 5–85). For the mothers themselves, febrile respiratory illness was reduced by 36% (95% CI 4–57). Two trials in South Africa used placebos, where neither doctors nor pregnant women knew which shot was administered. Among pregnant women without HIV infection, confirmed flu dropped from 3.6% to 1.8%, an efficacy of 50.4% (95% CI 14.5–71.2). In their infants, it dropped from 3.6% to 1.9%, an efficacy of 48.8% (95% CI 11.6–70.4). Combining 4 trials and 3 observational studies, confirmed influenza in infants under 6 months was approximately 48% lower (95% CI 33–59). Four observational studies looking at infant hospitalizations due to confirmed influenza showed a reduction of about 72% (95% CI 39–87). Another review pooled only two trials and found a 34% reduction in confirmed influenza (95% CI 15–50). However, there was no difference in the infants' "influenza-like illness," which refers to illness judged as flu-like by symptoms alone without laboratory testing. Maternal hospitalizations were analyzed from medical records across four countries from 2010 to 2016: hospitalizations due to confirmed influenza were approximately 40% lower among the vaccinated (95% CI 12–59). In terms of safety, a review gathered 40 studies: among vaccinated individuals, stillbirth had an aOR of 0.84 (0.65–1.08), and congenital anomalies were 1.03 (0.99–1.07), with both differences within the margin of error. Preterm birth was 0.87 (0.78–0.96), about 13% lower. A US study reviewed three flu seasons from 2012 to 2015: vaccination within 28 days prior to spontaneous abortion showed an aOR of 0.9 (0.6–1.5), with no association found. The Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention's 2026–2027 technical guidelines list pregnant women as a priority group for vaccination. It states that vaccination at any stage of pregnancy can protect infants under 6 months of age, with better efficacy achieved in the third trimester. Live attenuated vaccines are contraindicated in pregnant women.
entries.sources: World Health Organization (2022). Vaccines against influenza: WHO position paper – May 2022. Technical Guidelines for Seasonal Influenza Vaccination in China (2026–2027). <https://www.chinacdc.cn/jkyj/mygh02/jswj2026/202609/t20260902_1839739.html>
entries.notes: Controversy. A 2017 US study found that people who received a flu vaccine within 28 days before a miscarriage experienced more miscarriages (aOR 2.0, 1.1–3.6). The elevation occurred only among those who had also received a vaccine containing influenza A(H1N1) in the previous season. The authors themselves stated that this does not prove causality. The same team examined the subsequent three flu seasons and did not observe this association again; therefore, countries worldwide still advise that it can be administered at any stage of pregnancy. Some domestic flu vaccine package inserts still list pregnant women as a contraindication. Guidelines recommend selecting a brand whose package insert does not list pregnant women as a contraindication, and informing the vaccinating clinician that you are pregnant before the shot. Receive only the injectable inactivated vaccine. The nasal spray is a live attenuated vaccine, approved domestically only for ages 3 to 17, and is strictly prohibited in pregnant women. It is best to finish getting vaccinated before the local flu season begins, typically September to October. If you miss that window, catch-up vaccination is still available throughout the entire flu season. Infants under 6 months old cannot receive a flu vaccine, so this dose during pregnancy is the baby's primary protection during the first few months after birth. Cohabiting family members and infant caregivers are also priority vaccination groups; the accounting for adults getting flu vaccinations themselves can be found in Section 1, Item 20 (Getting the flu vaccine). The benefit column does not include mortality figures; the magnitude of benefit is determined based on confirmed influenza and hospitalization, with the rationale detailed in the verification log. The benefits accrue to yourself and your child.

entries.title: Lie on your side when going to sleep after 28 weeks of pregnancy—either the left or right side is fine, avoid sleeping flat on your back
entries.cost: Free. The difficulty lies in changing sleep posture for people accustomed to sleeping on their backs.
entries.summary: Going to sleep flat on your back after 28 weeks of pregnancy carries about 2.6 times the risk of stillbirth compared with sleeping on your side. Left side and right side are the same; just pick whichever is comfortable. If you wake up in the middle of the night on your back, do not panic—roll back onto your side and go back to sleep. This figure is based on retrospective recall and remains controversial.
entries.benefit: Stillbirth here refers to fetal death in the womb after 28 weeks of pregnancy. One pooled analysis combined raw individual data from five studies. Four were conducted in New Zealand, Australia, and the UK, and one was an international online survey. There were 851 pregnant women who experienced stillbirths, alongside 2,257 pregnant women with normal outcomes serving as controls. The methodology asked them retrospectively about their recent going-to-sleep position. Compared with falling asleep on the left side, the risk of stillbirth for falling asleep on the back had an aOR of 2.63 (95% CI 1.72–4.04, confidence interval), roughly 2.6 times. Falling asleep on the right side had an aOR of 1.04 (0.83–1.31), showing no difference from the left side. Across small-for-gestational-age infants, maternal obesity, and smoking, this association remained similar. The authors estimated that if all pregnant women after 28 weeks of gestation fell asleep on their sides, stillbirths during this stage could be reduced by about 5.8% (3.2%–9.2%). The UK National Health Service (NHS) lists "avoiding going to sleep on your back after 28 weeks of pregnancy" as one practice to reduce the risk of stillbirth. It also notes that if you wake up on your back, do not worry—simply roll back onto your side and go back to sleep.
entries.sources: Cronin RS, Li M, Thompson JMD, et al. (2019). An Individual Participant Data Meta-analysis of Maternal Going-to-Sleep Position, Interactions with Fetal Vulnerability, and the Risk of Late Stillbirth. EClinicalMedicine, 10, 49-57. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eclinm.2019.03.014>; Silver RM, Hunter S, Reddy UM, et al. (2019). Prospective Evaluation of Maternal Sleep Position Through 30 Weeks of Gestation and Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes. Obstetrics and Gynecology, 134(4), 667-676. <https://doi.org/10.1097/AOG.0000000000003458> (counter-study in the notes); NHS. Stillbirth. <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/stillbirth/>
entries.notes: Controversy. The numbers above all derive from retrospective recall. Mothers who lost a child may recall inaccurately, a limitation acknowledged by the authors themselves. Nor are there randomized controlled trials. A US study prospectively asked 8,706 first-time pregnant women about their sleep positions and followed outcomes. Up to 30 weeks of pregnancy, supine sleeping or non-left-lateral sleeping showed no association with stillbirth, small-for-gestational-age birth, or gestational hypertension (aOR 0.99, 0.89–1.11). However, it only tracked up to 30 weeks of gestation, with no records of sleep position in subsequent weeks. Side-sleeping is free and has no downsides, so the UK advises it regardless. Stillbirth itself is uncommon; late stillbirth in high-income countries occurs in roughly 1.3 to 8.8 cases per 1,000 births. The "large" benefit rating was applied mechanically based on the 2.6-fold increase, with the rationale detailed in the verification log. The benefits accrue to the child.

entries.title: Use contraception as soon as sexual intercourse resumes after childbirth; breastfeeding does not equal contraception; if you want another child, wait at least 18 months before conceiving again
entries.cost: A box of condoms costs several tens of yuan. IUD insertion and subdermal implants require a hospital visit, with prices varying by region. The difficulty lies in postpartum exhaustion and chaos, leaving little attention for this.
entries.summary: You can get pregnant again as early as 3 weeks after childbirth, even while breastfeeding and before your period returns. Breastfeeding acts as an effective barrier only when all three conditions are met: exclusive breastfeeding, no return of menses, and an infant under 6 months old. Conceiving again within 6 months of childbirth raises the risk of premature birth in the next pregnancy by about 40%. The World Health Organization recommends waiting at least two years after childbirth before conceiving again.
entries.benefit: The UK National Health Service (NHS) states that you can become pregnant as early as 3 weeks after giving birth, even if you are breastfeeding and your periods have not returned. Unless you intend to conceive immediately, use contraception every time you have sex. Relying on breastfeeding for contraception is called the lactational amenorrhea method (LAM), which requires meeting three criteria simultaneously: feeding only breast milk, no return of menses, and the baby being under 6 months old. Followed strictly, it prevents pregnancy in over 99% of cases. With less strict adherence, about 2 out of every 100 people become pregnant within 6 months. Switch to another method immediately if any of the following occur: the baby exceeds 6 months of age, formula/solids or pacifiers are introduced, your period returns (even spotting counts), night feeds stop, or nursing frequency declines. A meta-analysis combining 67 studies controlled for maternal age and socioeconomic status, using an interval of 18 to 23 months between the previous birth and the next conception as the reference. For intervals under 6 months, the odds ratio for preterm birth was OR 1.40 (95% CI 1.24–1.58, confidence interval), about 40% higher. Low birth weight was 1.61 (1.39–1.86), and small for gestational age was 1.26 (1.18–1.33). Intervals of 6 to 17 months and those exceeding 59 months were also elevated across all three outcomes. A Canadian study evaluating over 148,000 pregnancies compared a 6-month interval to an 18-month interval. For mothers aged 35 and older, maternal mortality or severe morbidity was 0.62% versus 0.26%, aRR 2.39 (2.03–2.80), about 2.4 times higher. For mothers aged 20 to 34, there was no significant difference (0.92, 0.83–1.02). For infants of mothers aged 20 to 34, the combined rate of stillbirth, infant death, extreme low birth weight, or extreme preterm birth was 2.0% versus 1.4%, aRR 1.42 (1.36–1.47). A 2005 World Health Organization technical consultation recommended waiting at least 24 months after a live birth before attempting another pregnancy. The experts unanimously agreed that conceiving within less than 18 months should be avoided. After a miscarriage or abortion, wait at least 6 months.
entries.sources: NHS. Sex and contraception after birth. <https://www.nhs.uk/baby/support-and-services/sex-and-contraception-after-birth/>; NHS. Natural family planning. <https://www.nhs.uk/contraception/methods-of-contraception/natural-family-planning/>; Conde-Agudelo A, Rosas-Bermúdez A, Kafury-Goeta AC (2006). Birth spacing and risk of adverse perinatal outcomes: a meta-analysis. JAMA, 295(15), 1809. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.295.15.1809>; Schummers L, Hutcheon JA, Hernandez-Diaz S, et al. (2018). Association of Short Interpregnancy Interval With Pregnancy Outcomes According to Maternal Age. JAMA Internal Medicine, 178(12), 1661. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jamainternmed.2018.4696>; World Health Organization (2007). Report of a WHO Technical Consultation on Birth Spacing, Geneva, 13–15 June 2005 (WHO/RHR/07.1). <https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/WHO-RHR-07.1>; Ball SJ, Pereira G, Jacoby P, de Klerk N, Stanley FJ (2014). Re-evaluation of link between interpregnancy interval and adverse birth outcomes: retrospective cohort study matching two intervals per mother. BMJ, 349, g4333. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.g4333> (counter-study in the notes)
entries.notes: Controversy. Recommendations differ regarding how long an interval is sufficient. Among WHO experts, one camp advocated for 18 months while another favored 27 months; 24 months was decided as a compromise between both sides. The NHS recommends at least 12 months. An Australian study comparing two intervals within the same mothers across 40,441 women yielded different conclusions. For intervals of 0 to 5 months, the OR for preterm birth was 1.07 (0.86–1.34) and for low birth weight was 1.03 (0.79–1.34), showing no discernible differences. When comparing across different mothers, preterm birth was 1.41. Thus, part of the risk of short intervals may stem from underlying maternal characteristics. Contraception itself is not controversial; the debate is solely over the spacing duration. According to the NHS, condoms and subdermal implants can be used immediately after childbirth, including while breastfeeding. For breastfeeding individuals using combined hormonal contraceptives, it is generally necessary to wait until at least 6 weeks postpartum. Which method to adopt should be discussed with a doctor during the 42-day postpartum checkup; see Item 16 (The 42-day postpartum checkup). The benefit rating of "moderate" is based on clinical judgment, with the rationale detailed in the verification log. The benefits accrue to yourself and your next child.

chapters.title: Do Not Ruin Your Body for the Sake of Appearance
chapters.intro:
This section covers several practices involving "intervening physically on your body to change appearance": starving, taking pills, injections, and surgery. Decisions regarding these actions are mostly driven by comparison with others, yet the costs fall entirely on oneself, and a substantial portion cannot be reversed.

This section does not judge what anyone wants to look like; that is a personal matter. For the same goal, one can seek options with "prescriptions, qualifications, and follow-ups," or opt for "online shopping, beauty salons, and self-increasing dosages." This section only compares the magnitude of risk between these two approaches. The accounting primarily examines actual physical harms, such as blindness, hospitalization, and death. The two entries on medical aesthetics also involve criminal liability for illegal medical practice.

entries.title: Do not control weight through extreme dieting, fasting, or self-induced vomiting; if you need to lose weight, do it from the exercise side
entries.cost: Free. In fact, it saves money on weight-loss products.
entries.summary: People with anorexia nervosa have approximately 5.9 times the mortality risk of peers of the same age. For every 1,000 individuals followed for one year, 5.1 die, with roughly one-fifth resulting from suicide. Dieters are more prone to developing eating disorders: following students across 44 secondary schools for three years, girls who engaged in severe dieting were 18 times more likely to develop an eating disorder than non-dieters. If you want to manage your weight, exercise more; do not cut food intake to the point of hunger.
entries.benefit: Calculated across 36 combined studies: the cohort with anorexia nervosa was followed for a cumulative 166,642 person-years (the sum of years each person was tracked). Their standardized mortality ratio was 5.86, meaning their probability of death was roughly 5.9 times that of peers their age. The mortality rate of 5.1 per 1,000 person-years translates to 5.1 deaths for every 1,000 people followed for a year. Approximately 1/5 of those who died died by suicide. The standardized mortality ratio for bulimia nervosa was 1.93, and for other eating disorders was 1.92, each roughly 1.9 times that of peers. Another study conducted across 44 secondary schools in Victoria, Australia, tracked students aged 14–15 over 3 years, assessing the same cohort across 6 waves. The incidence of new eating disorders among girls was 21.8 per 1,000 person-years—meaning 21.8 new cases emerged per 1,000 girls followed for a year. Girls on severe diets had an 18-fold higher risk of disease onset compared with non-dieters; for moderate dieters, it was 5-fold. After further adjusting for prior dieting and psychiatric symptoms—deducting the effects of "having dieted previously" and "baseline psychiatric symptoms"—BMI (body mass index, calculated as weight divided by height squared), physical activity levels, and sex no longer predicted new-onset eating disorders. The authors concluded that "controlling weight with exercise rather than dietary restriction appears to carry a lower risk of eating disorders in adolescents."
entries.sources: Arcelus J et al. (2011). Mortality rates in patients with anorexia nervosa and other eating disorders. A meta-analysis of 36 studies. Arch Gen Psychiatry. <https://doi.org/10.1001/archgenpsychiatry.2011.74>；Patton GC et al. (1999). Onset of adolescent eating disorders: population based cohort study over 3 years. BMJ. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.318.7186.765>
entries.notes: "Severe dieting" here refers to chronically suppressing food intake far below physiological needs, not skipping a single meal or passing on late-night snacks. If you are already experiencing self-induced vomiting, post-binge self-reproach, or compulsive weighing that you cannot stop, seek care in a psychiatry department or a clinical psychology clinic at a general hospital. This is a medical condition with standardized treatments, not a matter of willpower. The relationship between BMI and mortality can be found in Section 2, Item 32; that item discusses long-term weight ranges, not methods for weight reduction.

entries.title: Before injections, thread lifts, or surgery, check two things: whether the facility license includes "Medical Aesthetics" and whether the practitioner is an attending physician
entries.cost: Free. Verifying these two credentials takes only a few minutes. The institution is required to hang its Medical Institution Practicing License in the lobby. The physician's qualifications can be verified through the practicing physician inquiry portal of the health commission.
entries.summary: Procedures involving needles, surgical blades, or medical devices that puncture the skin or penetrate the body are considered medical practice. They may only be performed in facilities whose licenses explicitly list "Medical Aesthetics," and the practitioner must be a registered practicing physician. Beauty salons, private studios, and hotel rooms are not permissible. Procedures performed by individuals lacking medical qualifications constitute illegal medical practice; causing severe harm carries a prison sentence of 3 to 10 years, and causing death carries a sentence of 10 years or more.
entries.benefit: Article 2 of the Measures for the Administration of Medical Cosmetology Services defines medical cosmetology. The original text states: "the repair and reshaping of human appearance and morphology of various body parts using surgery, medications, medical devices, and other traumatic or invasive medical technical methods." In plain terms, as long as it breaks the skin, inserts a needle, or penetrates the body, it is treated as medical practice. Articles 8 and 24 require obtaining a Medical Institution Practicing License and securing approval for medical aesthetic clinical departments from the registering authority before operations can commence. If "Medical Aesthetics" is not designated on the license, procedures cannot be conducted. Article 11 mandates that the attending physician (the doctor performing the procedure) must hold practicing physician qualifications and be officially registered. Those performing aesthetic surgery must additionally possess over 6 years of clinical experience in relevant specialties; aesthetic dentistry requires over 5 years; aesthetic traditional Chinese medicine and aesthetic dermatology each require over 3 years. Article 20 mandates informing the patient in writing before the procedure regarding indications, contraindications (what conditions are suitable or unsuitable), medical risks, and precautions, as well as obtaining signed informed consent. Article 336 of the Criminal Law regulates illegal medical practice. Illegal medical practice refers to individuals administering injections, performing surgeries, or treating patients without physician practicing qualifications. If circumstances are serious, the penalty is fixed-term imprisonment of up to 3 years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, together with or solely with a fine. If serious damage is caused to the health of the patient, the penalty is fixed-term imprisonment of 3 to 10 years and a fine. If death is caused, the penalty is fixed-term imprisonment of 10 years or more and a fine.
entries.sources: Ministry of Health (2002). Measures for the Administration of Medical Cosmetology Services (Ministry of Health Order No. 19, Articles 2, 8, 11, 16, 20, 24). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2003/content_62198.htm>; National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 336). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>
entries.notes: Article 16 of the same measures also stipulates that medical aesthetic procedures may only be conducted within aesthetic medical institutions, or within hospitals and clinics that have established medical aesthetics departments. Therefore, in-home injection services or unauthorized operations inside private studios are already non-compliant based on location alone. Article 20 specifies that minors and others who cannot make independent decisions must obtain consent and signatures from a guardian to undergo medical aesthetic procedures. Facials, massage, and nail care fall under personal/lifestyle grooming and are not governed by these rules. However, whenever needles or scalpels are involved, it counts as medical aesthetics.

entries.title: Avoid the nasal dorsum, glabella, and forehead for facial fillers, and never seek unregulated injections to save money
entries.cost: Free. It simply involves choosing a different injection site or opting not to do it.
entries.summary: Among individuals blinded by filler injections, more than half had injections in the nose, followed by the glabella, forehead, and nasolabial folds; over 80% used hyaluronic acid. Among those blinded, only 20% experienced full vision recovery, over 10% experienced partial recovery, and nearly 20% suffered brain injury as well. Currently, no emergency salvage method is reliably effective, so these areas must be avoided beforehand.
entries.benefit: Aggregating cases reported in journals worldwide: from January 2015 to September 2018, there were 48 newly added cases of partial or complete vision loss following injectable filler procedures. The site with the most incidents was the nose, accounting for 56.3%. This was followed by the glabella at 27.1%, the forehead at 18.8%, and the nasolabial fold (the groove forming the laugh line) at 14.6%. In 81.3% of the cases, the filler material was hyaluronic acid (also known as sodium hyaluronate). 43.8% developed skin changes. 18.8% experienced central nervous system complications (problems in the brain). Vision fully recovered in 10 cases (20.8%) and partially recovered in 8 cases (16.7%), while the remainder did not recover. The authors concluded that treatment approaches varied widely across different practitioners and that no single treatment has been proven to work consistently.
entries.sources: Beleznay K et al. (2019). Update on Avoiding and Treating Blindness From Fillers: A Recent Review of the World Literature. Aesthet Surg J. <https://doi.org/10.1093/asj/sjz053>
entries.notes: These numbers were counted case by case from those reported in journals. They include only the number of people who experienced adverse events, not the total number of people who received injections. Therefore, it is impossible to calculate "what the probability of going blind from getting an injection is"; it only shows which sites have frequent incidents and that adverse outcomes are largely irreversible after the fact. This is also why the evidence is rated Grade B.
